reviews.text:
As always, tea at the Phoenician was wonderful!  Joined by my two best friends in honor of my Birthday, the food was delicious and the service impeccable. Natalie and Sabrina did a wonderful job... we missed Wanda!

For this visit, we sat on the platform near the windows which provided a beautiful view, although it was very warm and the noise level quite loud, (filled with the sounds of people enjoying their experience), which made it almost impossible to enjoy the pianist. 

None the less, I will return next month with friends from Tulsa and Spokane.

Thank you to the entire "TEA" team at the Phoenician!

reviews.text: Afternoon Tea at the Phoenician is such a cute, fun experience. My girlfriends and I did Afternoon Tea for a baby sprinkle brunch for one of our friends. We all dressed up in garden party attire with cute fascinators/hats. The tea choices were excellent and everyone enjoyed their selections. They have a few options for non-caffeinated teas which was nice since I don't drink caffeine. The Grand Royal Tea Enhancement is totally worth it, as they serve Perrier-Jouet champagne and its bottomless! There's a lady who plays the piano during tea which is a lovely touch. They were able to accommodate my gluten free, pescatarian friend as well (with advance notice of dietary restrictions). The tea sandwiches were ok, a couple were tasty, but overall I feel like the bread was a little dry. I did enjoy the lobster salad sandwich and the asparagus sandwich. The scones were tasty, but the dessert was the most delightful! Many mini desserts with great flavor and super cute. Afternoon Tea is a bit pricey, especially if you upgrade to include champagne but it's totally worth the experience! I'd definitely come enjoy Afternoon Tea again! :)

reviews.text:
​🕷️ Eerie Elegance: A Spooktacular Afternoon Tea Review 🕸️

​If you are looking for an afternoon tea experience that perfectly balances sophisticated elegance with festive, spooky fun, the "Eerie Elegance: An Afternoon Tea to Die For" at The Phoenician Scottsdale is an absolute must-visit. From the monochromatic gothic table settings to the intricately themed pastries, every detail of this experience is brilliantly executed.
The table setting was a gorgeous display of moody, Victorian-inspired Halloween glamour. A black lace runner overlays a striped pattern, accented by vibrant orange roses in black vases. The real showstopper is the tableware: a beautiful white teapot adorned with delicate black and orange butterflies, sitting alongside a bat-themed sugar bowl resting on a mini spiderweb coaster.
​The three-course meal kicks off with "Sinister Sandwiches & Savories" (featuring items like English Cucumber with Fresh Mint Cream Cheese and a Lemon & Thyme Chicken Salad).
The live pianist was a delight and the tea service was excellent.
the Full Halloween Tea (with options to upgrade to Champagne or Caviar packages), it is a premium experience that completely delivers on its theme. The creativity of the pastry chefs, combined with the upscale, eerie ambiance, makes this an unforgettable autumn celebration. Highly recommended for anyone looking to celebrate the spooky season in style!

reviews.text: My daughter and I had a great time at the Halloween afternoon tea! They were so accommodating and our waitress was wonderful. I can't wait to make this a monthly tradition for us!
reviews.author: Nittaya

reviews.text: Lovely, elegant Tea. Excellent tea selections of many varieties. Coconut cream was DIVINE!! Absolutely delicious sandwiches, scones, w/ clotted cream, lemon curd and jam and desserts. So beautifully presented! Live piano playing in the background made the whole experience so relaxing and serene. Highly recommend this classy, beautiful and elegant Tea.
reviews.author: doris

reviews.text: The experience was absolutely incredible. The staff was very friendly and accommodating. They gave great explanations of the food as it came out.  You will not leave that experience hungry!
reviews.author: Eric

reviews.text: What a special time! Wanda is exemplary and welcomes us like family. Highly recommend for those who love tea and a lovely experience!!
reviews.author: wendy

reviews.text: I took my 92 year old mother-in-law, daughter, and daughter-in-law.  Everyone had a fabulous time.  The layout was great, music delightful, service great, and a food delicious!
reviews.author: Deb

reviews.text: High Tea at the Phoenician is always my favorite!  I try to go once or twice a year.  It’s perfection from the ambiance to the service to the food! I can’t imagine a better high tea anywhere in the world.  It is pricey and getting more so every year but for a special occasion it’s the best!
reviews.author: Judy

reviews.text: Everything was wonderful - the food, the service, the ambiance…
reviews.author: Taryn

reviews.text: Always a special treat. Even more wonderful when servers recognize you and welcome you back warmly!
reviews.author: Debra

reviews.text: Tea was a great experience. We were celebrating a birthday and the staff made it a wonderful occasion. We will be back again. The food is always superb.
reviews.author: Kristi

reviews.text: High trees at the Phoenician is always a pleasurable experience.  The staff is very professional and the food and teas are delicious!
reviews.author: April

reviews.text: An absolute dreamy environment with delicious food, remarkable service and tasty tea.
reviews.author: Elaine

reviews.text: A lovely experience with my two daughters.  Everything was perfect!  The food, the ambiance, and the service were all top notch! We all had different dietary requests, a gluten free, a grain free, and regular service.  The chef did an amazing job making everything fabulous and delicious for all!
reviews.author: Sheela

reviews.text: Amazing as always! Great food and excellent views. We enjoyed the live piano music too.
reviews.author: Maria

reviews.text: Wanda, our fabulous server, made our afternoon so special, enjoyable and memorable. Food was wonderful tea was delightful, the afternoon couldn’t have been better.
reviews.author: Darryl

reviews.text: The sweetest hostess and wait staff. We booked massages and they accommodated us so well for my sisters 50th. They even sang happy bday to everyone early because we were on a time crunch. Such a great experience we will be back.
reviews.author: heather

reviews.text: Wanda and team gave excellent service! The ambience and pianist were also wonderful. Would love to visit again on my next visit to Scottsdale!
reviews.author: Meronne

reviews.text: Wanda, Sabrina and Raul made our tea experience outstanding! They provided excellent service and remembered me from last time. They were impressive with their level of service.
reviews.author: Julie

reviews.text: As always, the service was impeccable, the ambiance was relaxing and rejuvenating, and the staff was friendly and professional. This afternoon tea experience rivals the best of London.
reviews.author: Leslie

reviews.text: Lovely venue for my mother's 94th birthday tea!  Thanks to all staff for making her feel special!!
reviews.author: Cathy

reviews.text: sandwiches were not too fresh and didn't have much filling inside service was rushed and robotic. was seated in back by wall outside patio was not cleaned up from a prior storm that happened 4 days earlier. We will not go back to Phoenician again for afternoon tea. been before a couple times. The Service has gone downhill; sandwiches and tea are not the same. one server even said they changed their teas. Cost too much for stale and smaller sandwiches.
reviews.author: Sheila

reviews.text: The hostess Wanda is also friendly and efficient!  She always makes the afternoon and enjoyable event.
reviews.author: BILL

reviews.text: Outstanding as usual. The best afternoon tea service in the Phoenix metro area.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Always a real pleasure! The service was excellent and the food and presentation exemplary
reviews.author: Greg

reviews.text: Beautiful tea amongst the most special al Jews and an amazing pianist! Highly recommend
reviews.author: Carolyn

reviews.text: Afternoon tea at the Phoenician was divine! I felt like royalty for my birthday celebration with some close friends! We had a stunning view and were a table away from the beautiful piano being played by such a talented woman. There were several other bdays and they sang all of us happy birthday accompanied on the piano. I recognized so many of the songs and the staff, especially Wanda was the sweetest! She treated us so well and was truly an angel! 10/10 would go again.
reviews.author: Alexandra

reviews.text: In the summer it's dreadfully hot outside in Arizona but this was such a nice afternoon indoors in a temperature controlled environment with lots of light and positivity!  Don't miss this as an event to enjoy even during the hot summertime!
reviews.author: Tricia

reviews.text:
A lovely way to celebrate a special birthday.
The ambience and level of service was great.
Missed the tiered trays as every course was served with small plates. The lemon curd, strawberry jam and Devonshire cream for the scones was very good. Excellent choice of teas.
The champagne was wonderful and you could always ask for more tea sandwiches
Nice piano music in the background.
Overall a special place to spend the afternoon.
reviews.author: Joni

reviews.text: An elevated tea experience!￼ Was perfect for a special celebration.
reviews.author: Meg

reviews.text: We celebrated my mother’s birthday and the High Tea was wonderful!   Great service and the food was delicious
reviews.author: Jennifer

reviews.text: The tea at the Phoenician is a must!  The service is always top notch with stunning views and a piano player making it feel extra fancy.  Perfect day for the ladies!
reviews.author: YOLANDA

reviews.text:
I had a lovely afternoon with great company. Good food, great wine and yes there was tea. The service was outstanding I recommend it highly. 
Karen Serrano
reviews.author: Karen

reviews.text: Lovely afternoon sipping tea and enjoying delicious finger sandwiches, scones and deserts with good friends. Great way to relax and catch up ! Service is always wonderful - Afternoon Tea staff at The Phoenician are always so welcoming and amazing. Perfect afternoon out each time we go.
reviews.author: Stephanie

reviews.text: We celebrated our 7year wedding anniversary with our two little girls. The facility was welcoming, valet was covered and a sweet anniversary dessert was on the table when we arrived. The staff was kind to our kids and even gave us plenty of to-go boxes as our kids were unable to finish their last course. The pianist was playing updated and great song choices through out the experience. I would recommend this place to anyone who loves a good afternoon tea.
reviews.author: russhell

reviews.text:
What a lovely experience at Afternoon Tea.
From start to finish, it was magical. The ambiance was spectacular, the food was delicious and the service was top notch. We will definitely repeat the experience.
reviews.author: Adriana

reviews.text: Wonderful experience to celebrate birthdays with my daughter. Loved the ambiance, food, service, and live piano music!
reviews.author: Leslie

reviews.text: Wanda and Raul and everyone on staff was amazing as they always have been. The tea was wonderful, champagne, and all of the foods. However, it was almost unbearably hot because of the broken front door. We felt very badly for all the staff because it was so hot in there. We’ve been coming to tea for 20 years and will continue. Hopefully the door is fixed ASAP for the staff there!￼￼
reviews.author: Jill

reviews.text: We were a party of 7 (which included a child).  The server (sorry I forgot her name), was very prompt with handing her Mom a chid's menu; and serving a plate of non-dairy little sandwiches to one of our guests who requested non-dairy.  The hostess, Lilliana, was also warn & very welcoming!
reviews.author: MAJELLA

reviews.text: Love it every time!!! Fun time & memories. Delicious and fresh.
reviews.author: Bridget

reviews.text: Maybe the Phoenician can have a buffet style option where we get option to choose which sandwiches and pastries we pick to be served at our tables,
reviews.author: Taniya

reviews.text: Absolutely fantastic! As always, the Afternoon Tea at The Phoenician is exceptional. Took my mom for her 78th birthday and my 13 yr old twins for their first tea experience. I fear I may have spoiled them for all other afternoon teas as this one is the best. Excellent service, wonderful ambiance, fantastic food, and a delicious variety of teas. It was a little loud as we were right next to the piano.
reviews.author: Barbara

reviews.text: Our servers were lovely. We had such a wonderful time.
reviews.author: M

reviews.text: The ambience and seating area is beautiful. Service felt rushed to move on to next courses. Sandwiches were decent, scones a bit crumbly but dessert course was just not good
reviews.author: Sam

reviews.text: My mother and I visit The Phoenician for formal afternoon tea annually around the holiday season but this year she wanted to dine for her birthday too. Year after year we recognize familiar faces amongst the tea service staff and it’s so appreciated when we are also recognized. Our waitress this visit was Natali and per usual, she ensured we had a wonderful experience. As always, the sandwiches, scones, and desserts were delicious and the tea was hot. I look forward to our next visit this December!
reviews.author: Elizabeth

reviews.text: I thoroughly enjoyed the afternoon tea friendly staff and create food !
reviews.author: brenda

reviews.text: It was my first time for Afternoon tea here at The Phoenician and it was wonderful. I would highly recommend this, especially if you have out-of-town visitors . The tea sandwiches, scones, and OMG the pastries were divine . I enjoyed the champagne and the coconut tea was delicious. . It’s a very lovely setting. Would definitely do this again.
reviews.author: Rebecca

reviews.text: Great experience, great food, and great service. Will definitely come back
reviews.author: Enrique

reviews.text: Such a special experience. Perfect for a special occasion.
reviews.author: Jennifer

reviews.text: Perfect high tea experience. Especially loved the live piano music.
reviews.author: Lisa

reviews.text: The most delightful way to experience an afternoon in the Scottsdale Phoenix area! The attention to detail in every flavor, texture, color, combination of tastes is thought out with perfection. Nothing is lost on tradition, customer service is impeccable, you leave with a full stomach and a happy heart! It’s my girls and my new obsession!!
reviews.author: Britony

reviews.text: We had a wonderful time at Afternoon Tea. The staff was very attentive and made the experience all the more enjoyable. Highly recommend the champagne and caviar paring. Lilly, Wanda and Raul are true professionals that love what they do and it definitely shows in the exceptional service they give. We will definitely be back, if we can get a reservation!
reviews.author: Shana

reviews.text: The treats and tea were tasty, but not even close to worth the price. There are plenty of other tea experiences in the phoenix area to go to for half the price.
reviews.author: Noah

reviews.text: Hi tea is a lovely event here. They serve a variety of sandwiches based on your food, allergies and preferences. The scones are delicious and there’s a variety of desserts. The atmosphere is lovely.
reviews.author: Marcia

reviews.text:
We have made the Phoenician Afternoon Tea a tradition for the past 5 years.  We are now exposing our new toddler granddaughter to that tradition and looking forward to many years of continuing this tradition.
Wanda, our server, has taken care of us every time. She’s always a delight and eager to please. The pianist, Lisa, was lovely as well. She was kind enough to play a Disney favorite for our granddaughter, which  made her want to dance for a few minutes. We are making meaningful family memories at The Phoenician, that will last a lifetime. The white coconut tea was delicious, as were all the other tea sandwiches, scones, and desserts. The vibe is always lovely and we always feel like it’s a ‘special’ time for us.
Liliana and Destiny were also wonderful, as they took time to chat with us and make us feel comfortable. Thank you again for being a part of our memories.
reviews.author: Sandy

reviews.text: The staff is incredible. We’ve been going there for over 20 yrs and the same staff is there creating a beautiful experience. The food has not changed mush of at all - that’s great! We love that the menu is exactly how we remember it and it is still a fabulous menu
reviews.author: Denise

reviews.text: The staff are amazing. So attentive and generous. The room is lovely and the piano music beautiful. The only downside (out of the staff’s control) was a large table of younger women who were terribly loud the whole time. Sitting between us and the piano made it difficult to hear the music. That said, I will go again soon. I took my mother for Mother’s Day and she loved it.
reviews.author: Vicki

reviews.text: We had the best time with our 22 month old son. They have the kindest staff. The pianist played some really beautiful modern songs in a classical style. It was magic. The food was phenomenal.
reviews.author: Melanie

reviews.text: We had a lovely time! The experience was great & they accommodated small children. We loved it!
reviews.author: Kendra

reviews.text: A fun event for a birthday! Service was outstanding and the hospitality was superb. Great place to venture out for tea and take in the views! Made the celebration very special.
reviews.author: Jilleen

reviews.text: My husband and I came to celebrate our birthdays, and it was wonderful. Wanda and Natalie are absolute treasures when it comes to experiencing Afternoon Tea at the Phoenician ❤️
reviews.author: Zybrena

reviews.text: Had an amazing time for my daughter’s birthday celebration. They even had a small birthday dessert on the table when we arrived. The food was delicious and the service was excellent.
reviews.author: Lianne

reviews.text: This was a special treat, with kind and attentive staff, delicious food and beautiful piano music.
reviews.author: Nicole

reviews.text: Afternoon Tea at the Phoenician.  Food, ample amount, served beautifully and very tasty.  The service, 5 stars.  The ambiance was distracting.  We were situated in the lobby that was roped off.  There were people walking around in their bathing suits, talking loudly, several gentlemen without shirts on in flip flops.  There was a T V on showing a golf tournament.  Each of us paid 278.00 for this experience and it was not enjoyable. The Phoenician can do better than that.  Extremely disappointing and we will not return.
reviews.author: Lorraine

reviews.text: Beautiful service, lovely servers, and refills on champagne!
reviews.author: Anthony

reviews.text: I cannot say enough good things about the Phoenician Tea Room experience! The staff is incredibly welcoming, and we always see the same friendly faces when we visit—they truly treat us like royalty. The food is not only delicious but also beautifully presented, making every bite a delight. Adding to the charm, a talented pianist serenades us on a grand piano while we soak in the breathtaking views. Every visit is an absolute joy, and we are so grateful for the consistently exceptional service. Thank you for always creating such a wonderful afternoon!
reviews.author: Jill

reviews.text:
Afternoon Tea was amazing as always!  The staff is so attentive and welcoming! Sabrina and Mrs.Wanda are the best!
I just love going to the Phoenician for tea - for special events or just for a great Saturday get away.  Your establishment does an amazing job at all of it! Thank you!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Wanda is the best! Give that woman a raise! We love the service, food, live music, and view. The tea room is too loud.
reviews.author: AnneF

reviews.text: Wonderful experience! The food was so delicious, the atmosphere was lovely. Can’t wait to come back.
reviews.author: cathy

reviews.text:
This was our 2nd time for afternoon tea at The Phoenician and it was as fabulous as the 1st time.

It’s overall a fun experience but the service is what makes it so special. The staff are attentive, funny, and accommodating. They make it seem like they are having as much fun as you are.

Definitely a worthwhile experience.
reviews.author: Shannon

reviews.text: A perfect day thanks to the Phoenician experience. The staff made us all feel so welcome and like the rock stars we think we are. Thank you for the service and the amazing food!  Just enough for afternoon tea with my gorgeous girls.  The Phoenician makes the time so memorable.
reviews.author: Monika

reviews.text: Yes yes yes. Best experience and Wanda is the absolute best!
reviews.author: Mauri

reviews.text: Excellent experience as always. Wanda, who has been our server for many years, was wonderful. My daughter and I having been going there for afternoon tea for her birthday for 20 years. I would highly recommend going if you have the opportunity to do so.
reviews.author: PamM

reviews.text: A total great experience!  Wanda and Raul are delightful, their service was impeccable!  We always enjoy Lisa at the piano and her amazing music!
reviews.author: CONNIET

reviews.text: I had an AMAZING time. I went alone and wasn’t sure how that would be but I ended up getting a gorgeous window seat by myself and off to the side. Had good people watching and view of the piano and palm trees. My waitress was I want to say named Wanda or Paula maybe?? There were only two on the floor and she was so sweet. It is worth the cost and I went right at the start so I could chill for a while. Afterwards I wanted to take a photo but I was alone. Kelsey who worked at the bar took my pictures and was so friendly!!!Thank you to the Phoenician Team!!!
reviews.author: Veronica

reviews.text: Absolutely wonderful experience to celebrate a birthday or special occasion! Everything was top notch!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Delightful! This is an annual treat for my girlfriend group. From the finger sandwiches to detailed team service, we look forward to this every year. Wanda’s always incredibly welcoming and sets the tone for our celebrations. Keep shining, y’all!
reviews.author: Alicia

reviews.text: Lovely experience. Pianist was a lovely touch. Service was superior. Too much food actually - would have probably preferred to have more than one tea each - but the actual event was wonderful and I would highly recommend.
reviews.author: Sandy

reviews.text: Wanda was nothing short of incredible. From the moment we arrived, she created an atmosphere that felt welcoming and warm, making everyone feel right at home. The little ones were especially thrilled by her thoughtful gestures; she took the time to give each child a small, delightful toy to take home, which truly made them feel special and cherished. Every aspect of our experience was flawless, from the cozy ambiance to the attention to detail in the service. While the prices were on the higher side, the quality and overall experience were undoubtedly worth every penny.
reviews.author: diamond

reviews.text:
We had a wonderful afternoon tea experience in a beautiful atmosphere - fresh flowers, views of resort, peaceful live piano. 

We made reservations a few days in advance and were seated immediately upon arrival. We had the "full tea" which for each person included a pot of tea and 3 courses of food: tea sandwiches, scones, and sweets. All items were carefully crafted in both taste and presentation. My favorite items were the lobster salad sandwich and the buttermilk scone with Devonshire cream. The sweets were too rich and sweet in my opinion, but still beautifully made.

Our servers were friendly, welcoming, and attentive - they even offered seconds for the sandwiches. For the birthday we were celebrating, we were given an extra dessert and the pianist and servers made sure to sing "happy birthday" too!

Overall, this was a delightful experience! The only drawbacks are that the price is expensive (in comparison to other high tea restaurants), and the portions are small.
reviews.author: Adrienne

reviews.text: It was the perfect Valentines Day afternoon tea with my beautiful wife❤️
reviews.author: Bruce

reviews.text:
Wanda always makes the Afternoon Tea a special occasion.  The piano musician always plays music that is both lively and interesting.

The teas, food and sparkling wines are always perfect!
reviews.author: BILL

reviews.text: Our server, Wanda, was AMAZING! She sang Happy Birthday to everyone in the place and it was lively!
reviews.author: ShellyS

reviews.text: Beautiful service, food and experience.  I would recommend anyone to enjoy this event.
reviews.author: Barbara

reviews.text: Love afternoon tea at The Phoenician, we go at least once a year and it is always enjoyable with the fantastic piano player and tea staff! The views also cannot be beat!
reviews.author: Christina

reviews.text: Artfully prepared food. Friendly service. A bit expensive but worth it.
reviews.author: Debra

reviews.text: The best experience! Highly recommend Wanda and the white coconut cream tea.
reviews.author: kristi

reviews.text: We had a wonderful experience! I was sad and a little disappointed to see that Black Currant was removed from the menu. The other teas just didn’t do it for me but I did enjoy the food, service, and ambience.
reviews.author: Talene

reviews.text: Sabrina is amazing! Her service is the best!! Love her!
reviews.author: Stacy

reviews.text: As always the staff at the Phoenician do a great job!  Service was excellent!!
reviews.author: Mark

reviews.text: It was an amazing  birthday celebration!  I have enjoyed this service multiple times.  We had 2 newbies today and they were very impressed!
reviews.author: Pat

reviews.text: The food and service were incredible. We’ve done tea before, and this exceeded our expectations! ￼

reviews.text: Holiday tradition for us! We love coming back year after year

reviews.text: The most magical day having afternoon tea at the Phoenician
reviews.author: Haley

reviews.text: We have been to tea two other times prior to this experience.  It has become a mother, daughter tradition and we have enjoyed each occasion coming to tea.  Unfortunately, on this occasion our server was pre-occupied and not at her best.  We have had her before, and she was great.  I hate to criticize but lack of service did lead to us enjoying the experience less.  It was clear there was a regular in attendance for Holiday Tea, and our server spent most of our experience catering to him.  I don't have an issue with that, as long as our needs are not overlooked.  We will be looking for alternative tea locations to continue our tradition.
reviews.author: Lauri

reviews.text: Afternoon Tea never disappoints.  My daughter and I attend every year. We are cocooned in a soothing ambiance, with a soft hush overall, with attentive friendly staff and always plates of delicious savory and sweets.
reviews.author: Jo

reviews.text: Ample food in a beautiful holiday setting with wonderful service!
reviews.author: Cindy

reviews.text: Wonderful experience and they were quite accommodating of a baby and 5 year old. They even brought out toys and tiny treats just for the kids. It was so special. We can’t wait to make it a tradition!
reviews.author: Jodie

reviews.text: A fantastic experience every time! The staff is attentive and lovely, love going every year!
reviews.author: Katie

reviews.text: This is our fourth year at the Phoenician Christmas afternoon tea.   We absolutely love it.  Although pricey, we look forward to it every year.  The food, tea and service are excellent.  Unfortunately, this year we didn't get our annual picture copies in front of the Christmas tree which has become a treasured tradition for us.   Look forward to next year.
reviews.author: Tim

reviews.text: Holiday Tea was a lovely experience, as usual for the Phoenician. Santa even made an appearance later on in the afternoon.
reviews.author: Ann

reviews.text: We ordered  a vegan meal when they confirmed our reservation just before hand  and they had nothing for us except for a few little bites since they said they did not show record of vegan meal. For $ 140.00 per person after 22% tip I expected much more.  It really was not worth the money even for regular menu. No towers presentation of food just a preset little plate for each 3 courses. Finger sandwiches, scones & beautiful tiny desserts that tasted very premade…
reviews.author: Tricia Ernie

reviews.text: Excellent spot for an eclectic afternoon tea in the Phoenix metro area.
reviews.author: James

reviews.text: My mother and I have been going to afternoon tea for over 30 years! Usually every March for our birthdays and around Christmas time! I’ve been to tea all over the world and the Phoenician is absolutely the best! The little sandwiches are so fresh and delectable! The scones with homemade Devonshire cream and lemon curd melt in your mouth and if you have room after all that the pastry’s are decadent! Not to mention my favorite Jasmine pearl tea that smells like the tropics! Also I always have champagne too! The wait staff is phenomenal and if you are lucky enough to have Wanda you are in for a treat! We love her!!
reviews.author: Stacey

reviews.text: Bright, elegant setting. Multiple delightful courses. Thoughtful and attentive service. A wonderful experience for our family!  Many thanks to Wanda and the Phoenician Tea Team!
reviews.author: Nicole

reviews.text: I took my mum from Australia to tea for her 75th birthday and it was a very memorable and wonderful experience! Our server Sabrina went above and beyond to make the experience so special! 5 star service, food and ambiance. We also loved the beautiful soft live piano music. It was an absolute delight! Thank you!!!
reviews.author: Emma

reviews.text: The service was very good. All the servers were well informed about what they were serving and were very pleasant. However, I felt that we were on an assembly line.the food was adequate..not great. Everything was formularic. I felt rushed even as they said we could relax. I could barely hear the piano music, which was coming from an adjacent room..they should at least have speakers in the actual "tea room" .The ambience in the room was lacking..there was only one Christmas wreath hung in the room…although the hotel lobby was well decorated for the holiday. They took a "complementary " picture of our group..a nice touch however the resulting print was very dark on the subjects because of the lights on the tree behind us. They shouldn’t have bothered. Very disappointing!overall, for the cost, I could not recommend this event to anyone.
reviews.author: Maggie

reviews.text: Holiday Tea at the Phoenician is always a delight! The delicate piano music paired well with our delicious teas, sandwiches, scones, and gorgeous desserts.  The service is always impeccable, and the atmosphere is perfect for a lovely afternoon with friends.
reviews.author: Rebecca

reviews.text: Disappointing.  There are better high teas around town.  Overpriced as well.

reviews.text: Food was good, not great. The fillings in course one sandwiches seemed a bit thin and service seemed a bit rushed as the afternoon wore on. Champagne flowed nonstop. The ambience was perfect, just a bit noisy from the crowd, so you couldn't hear the piano.
reviews.author: Denise

reviews.text: Great exprience for afternoon tea. Outstanding service from the team. The food was delicious.
reviews.author: Claudia

reviews.text: A nice experience, great service. Not a great value and very noisy inside. Enjoyed the tea and accompaniments. Something special to do once in a while.
reviews.author: Jaimie

reviews.text: Great service the food kept coming and everything was first class
reviews.author: Allen

reviews.text: We sat right next to the piano so we had a little hard time hearing our conversation but we also had fun playing “what’s that tune” It was a lovely location with a lovely staff and a lovely tea. Thank you.

reviews.text:
My daughters in law and I attend tea at The Phoenician every year before Thanksgiving. We thoroughly enjoy and look forward to our experience together.  This year was no exception!  The ambience and service were excellent and we look forward to our next visit!

Thank you!
reviews.author: Paula

reviews.text: The service was outstanding! The tea was even better! The food was delicious as well. The pianist was beautiful The volume was high though. As soon as I walked into the lobby, I could hear loud chatter from the tea area and the table, we couldn’t hear each other.
reviews.author: Jessica

reviews.text: Afternoon Tea at the Phoenician was lovely. Overall service was amazing. Ambiance was relaxed, elegant, and inviting. The view was beautiful. The sandwiches, tea selection, and champagne were really good. We did request some bread and butter for my friend who wanted something plain for her stomach and were told "no." For the price and previous hospitality experiences, I would hope that request would have been fulfilled. That was the only disappointment. I would go again. It was a great way to start the holiday season.
reviews.author: Tara

reviews.text: Excellent food and service. The piano music was great for a calm mood.
reviews.author: Julia

reviews.text: This was a very elegant fun way to spend the afternoon!  Something that was on my bucket list and it did not disappoint!
reviews.author: Ruth

reviews.text: Love Afternoon Tea at the Phoenician!  Food, service, and piano music are outstanding.  Better than afternoon tea in London, in my opinion!
reviews.author: Cheryl

reviews.text: Service was excellent. Food was plentiful but it was nothing special. For the hefty price tag, I was expecting more modern/artistic food. It was all fine but nothing inspired. The piano music added to the lovely ambience.
reviews.author: Lorri

reviews.text: We had so much fun!  Enjoyed champagne with our tea.  The good times kept rolling and rolling.
reviews.author: Julie

reviews.text: We always love the pianist that plays during high tea. She is amazing and she played a few songs for us on request. The staff was great.
reviews.author: paola

reviews.text: It's a pretty pricey option so for the food to be all pre-made and bland it was quite underwhelming.  The desserts were also just not great. The tea itself was delicious.  The servers were delightful.  I expected it to be in a nicer area of the hotel not right next to the bar with people in bathing suits, but now I know the ambiance for the future.
reviews.author: Karli

reviews.text: The staff at the Phoenician Tea are attentive and so kind.

reviews.text:
Today was a very special occasion. Our family enjoyed afternoon tea at The Phoenician @phoenicianscottsdale to celebrate Pi Day. We all agreed this was an amazing experience and worth the cost. Service was excellent and the teas were delicious. We sampled five teas (one pot for each of us):
- Lavender Chamomile Rose Herbal Tea
- White Winter Chai White Tea
- Jasmine Pearls Green Tea
- Assam Gold Black Tea
- Plum Oolong Black Tea
We enjoyed three courses:
1st - Finger Sandwich & Savories
2nd - Buttermilk & Cranberry Scones
3rd - Sweet Delicacies
And the Royal Caviar Enhancement
This was our first time trying caviar. Our tea server was so helpful and gracious, explaining every detail and way of consuming the roe or fish eggs with beignets, créme fraiche, egg whites, egg yolks, lemon, and chives.
We have been to high teas at other locations in North Carolina and around the country. I would say that by far this was the afternoon tea that will stay with us for a lifetime. This was truly a memorable, positive experience. The tea servers were extremely friendly and welcoming. They explained how to pour tea and eat caviar without making us feel intimidated in anyway, so if you are a beginner or first timer, please don't hesitate to come in. The setting of the tea room is just perfect for the afternoon sun and golden hour light. We were set at a booth near the interior of the tea room, facing outward towards the patio and the floor to ceiling windows and glass doors that lead in the sunlit views of the Scottsdale mountains and palm trees in the distance.
Also, we usually found ourselves a little bit hungry still, after an afternoon tea at other spots. Don't worry about being hungry after this tea experience. We had two grown men with us, one is a 21-year-old who can eat a lot. They were both very satisfied. The first course is served and then another round of sandwiches is offered to anyone who would like. The second course of scones really tops one off.

reviews.text:
Overall, the afternoon tea at the Phoenician was good.

Pros:
- The sandwiches and scones were very good.
- Nice tea selection.
- The service was excellent.
- Nice view from the windows.
- If you park with the valet the $28 cost is waived, you just need the hostess to validate your parking before you’re seated.

Cons:
- I wish that they served the food on a 3 tier stand instead they serve each part of the afternoon tea separately (first you have your sandwiches then when you’re done they will give you scones and then desserts).
- The desserts could have been better. The best dessert was the chocolate covered strawberry. The rest was overly sweet and forgettable.
- Noisy. The location is off of the lobby against the large windows, next to the bar, which I found to be rather noisy, especially the clanking of the glasses from the bar. The pianist did a wonderful job & her beautiful playing helped to drown out some of the noise from the bar and lobby.
- Presentation could be improved. The table linens were wrinkled and had fold marks.

We have seen the price of Afternoon Tea rise dramatically in the past few years, with the basic tea service now at $100.  Yesterday, we celebrated the season and saw a new offering...a "finishing tea", which was subtle tasting but seemed to require too much effort by the staff, the apparatus appeared to take over a table when seating is usually limited and seemed to me an effort to justify the high price.  A "finishing tea"... after already having multiple cups of tea...is overkill.  Sadly, my friend and I will limit our tea at the Phoenician to just once a year and will explore other tea rooms around the valley.

reviews.author: JacquelineF

reviews.text: I have come to afternoon tea for my birthday every year for many years. Going forward I am going to have to reconsider due to the ever increasing high cost of afternoon tea. I love to invite my friends but I have a hard time justifying asking them to pay $150 when including tip and tax. It is getting a bit outrageous which makes me sad as it is the best afternoon tea that I have ever had and I am from the UK.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Just a little pricey per person. But excellent service and ambience.
reviews.author: Ange

reviews.text: Amazing!  Even better than the afternoon tea we had in London this summer!
reviews.author: CherylM

reviews.text: This is my favorite thing to do for celebrations and the Phoenician has been the best BY FAR in so many ways but especially accommodating various food allergies! We had some pretty specific and kind of complicated ones and they not only made it work, but everyone had so many options to eat! Will definitely be back again as it is my go to afternoon tea in the valley
reviews.author: MadelineR

reviews.text: Excellent experience. The service was top tier the 3 courses were beyond filling.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
It’s an absolute MUST. We just missed the holiday tea, but the Christmas decor was still up and it was beautiful. There isn’t one detail that they missed. The tea sets are stunning, food is great, the atmosphere is amazing and the live pianist was magical.

Our server, Sabrina, was fantastic. She was extremely patient with us and helped us select teas that would compliment each other and the sandwiches best.

We had a great experience and will definitely be returning.
reviews.author: KayM

reviews.text: Afternoon tea was fabulous. It was a special treat to start 2024. I enjoyed the piano music, food and service. I would attend again next holiday season.
reviews.author: Danielle

reviews.text: This was our 7th tea at The Phoenician and while it has always been something we have enjoyed, this one was a bit disappointing, (1) in previous years when we finished the sandwich portion there was a waitress immediately at tableside offering seconds.  This did not happen and we had to ask for additional favorites.  The scones were excellent and pastries OK.  And (2) since it was a holiday tea, we had pictures taken of our party, that we never received.  In previous years, they had been delivered to our table.  So for the price, it was less than perfect.
reviews.author: JoanneV

reviews.text: Always a lovely event. Wanda has been our hostess/waitress for a number of years and she is always wonderful!
reviews.author: AnnM

reviews.text: We always have such a great experience at Afternoon Tea. It’s well worth the price.
reviews.author: Fher

reviews.text: High tea was amazing with an elegant ambiance, outstanding food and attentive waitstaff!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: I thought it was very nice... no rush, and pleasant.  A bit noisy at times
reviews.author: AnneM

reviews.text: Had a really lovely afternoon at the holiday tea. The sandwiches were all delicious, the desserts were wonderful and live piano and friendly servers put it over the top! We were there for about 1.5 hours, received a complimentary photo for each person in our party, a tea strainer, and validated parking. Wouldn’t let my husband see the bill so as not to spoil the afternoon lol.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Amazing Holiday Tea. Exceptional service and the food was delicious and beautifully presented.
reviews.author: Lindy23

reviews.text:
It was amazing!!! I took my mother- and sister-in-law and we had an amazing time. The food was incredible, and the service impeccable. The only slightly negative part of the experience was our table. It was low and we couldn't put our legs under it, which was a bit difficult for my mother-in-law. I will request a regular table next time.
But truly a really fabulous way to spend an afternoon. We will definitely return!
reviews.author: JenW

reviews.text: I have been attending tea for many years. I have to say that I am beginning to feel that the price isn’t worth it.  I was disappointed in the sandwiches:  The asparagus sandwich bread was soggy. The chicken salad and egg salad sandwich fillings were barely there - it was mostly bread. I did like the lobster salad sandwich.  The biscuits were both good. The desserts were beautiful to the eye but the taste didn’t wow.  Service was excellent, though.
reviews.author: CindyC

reviews.text: I’ve been to the holiday tea several times over the years. I was disappointed that the food quality and service has gone down substantially. For a minimum price of $$110 for the basic tea per person, there are high expectations. The bread was not fresh on the sandwiches, and the scones were soggy on one side. Also, service was aloof. They seemed to just be going through the motions and it was not the excellent service I’m used to. The ambiance is always lovely and I do like that they added a complimentary photo this year.
reviews.author: JaneeG

reviews.text: Food was mediocre, but service and ambience was great! Expensive but a great experience for a once in awhile treat.
reviews.author: DebbieW

reviews.text: Afternoon Tea at the Phoenician was pleasurable.  We enjoyed the atmosphere and the service more than the food.  That being said, this is not a place I would go frequently but one that I would consider bringing guests and clients.
reviews.author: MindyT

reviews.text: The price has increased which I no longer think is worth it. As well as they got rid of a lot of teas that they have had for years. That was disappointing. Used to love coming but unfortunately think that has come to an end.
reviews.author: CierraM

reviews.text: Tea is a family tradition at the Phoenician! This year I was quite disappointed as not only the price was raised but the food quality was not nearly as good as years passed. The sandwiches had little to no filling so it was mostly bread, biscuits were the same (always great)  and new desserts were also a delight but they did not offer a second serving like years passed. Unfortunately my entire group left a little disappointed and will most likely skip or recreate our own tea after this disappointing day.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: We absolutely love coming to afternoon tea at the Phoenician to kick off the holiday season! Everything is over the top lovely. We also appreciate the little touches like the printed photographs to take home and the wonderful food. The only thing we would change is the comfort level of sitting at the low tables. It’s not ideal to try and eat while wearing dresses and sitting in over stuffed chairs and low coffee tables. We would prefer sitting in a regular height table and will be sure to ask for that next year.
reviews.author: 5Ships

reviews.text:
The Phoenician is the lovliest Afternoon Tea spot in AZ. We are always greeted warmly and happily, and chatted with when they checkning with us. Very attentive ladies, they work very hard. 
The Foods are delicious and beautifully prepared. So many Tea choices. 
We enjoy the Live Piano background music, and the gorgeous View. 
Tea at the Phoenician is 10/10 every time!
reviews.author: KimberlyH

reviews.text: Fabulous as always.  Food delicious, tea was tasty
reviews.author: NicoleK

reviews.text: Great ambience and service! The food is good but I wish there’s more selection.
reviews.author: JOANNEW

reviews.text: This was by far the best tea experience I have ever had. I was just in London, and went to Tea and this one is 10 times better. The service, food, atmosphere are all exceptional. I would highly recommend. I took my mom and young daughter and it was such a joyful time. They take excellent care of younger ones. The live pianist was also incredible.
reviews.author: EmilyS

reviews.text:
Tea Service was wonderful.  I particularly enjoyed  the sandwiches and scones. Was very disappointed in the desserts.. seemed like they relied on trite chocolate
Decorations and some awful pastry cream with artificial
Flavors. Mine were one bite and tossed.
reviews.author: Desertkitty

reviews.text: My daughters and I had a wonderful time at Christmas Tea. The food was delicious and the service was impeccable.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: We have been coming for Tea for years (10+) and this year was not as good as in the past. The service seemed rushed even though we did stay for a long time. The sandwiches were great except the lobster was very fishy and no one could eat it. The scones where over cooked and the deserts where overall too blah. It was nice to see the mango desert was still good. We did the Grand Royal Tea. The tea service is dated and needs replacing (it has been there since my first visit) as the gold leaf is coming off from over use - yucky to think of others when you have a drink of tea. The Christmas event is so nice with the trees and piano music but not worth $650 (after service fee) for three of us. We will most likely do our own Tea Event next year.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: This is the best thing about The Phoenician! What a treat! Servers are wonderful. Food offerings are delicious and the champagne is flowing. I would highly recommend this experience, especially at the holidays.
reviews.author: Vogue

reviews.text: Sadly this was a big miss for us. The food was terrible, all the sandwiches were completely dry, or soggy depending on which you had. Tasted like they were old. The scones  were dry and not even warm. Then the dessert course again was all premade and dried out nothing seemed to be fresh. The service or lack their of was like we were in a whirlwind. The server come overs rattles things off and provides nothing more then a quick lis of what is placed and in front of you and then sprints away. After surveying the room this was not because they were busy there were several open tables and very few large parties. They should consider slowly describing the items and also provide a nice guide or menu with each course especially if they are in such a hurry and cant spend any time at your table.  The best part was the actual tea itself, which you poor yourself, and request for more warm water.  Overall, i would not recommend. The worst part was they put a nice service fee of of 22% for less then ideal service and  stale/soggy sanwiches.  I come from the hospitality industry and this was not the level of service that should be offered at a high tea at a luxury property. Disappointing.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: This MUST become a tradition! So elegant and perfect in every way
reviews.author: KristynH

reviews.text: Afternoon tea was a fabulous experience. The tea and food were both tasty and artistically presented. I took my 3 year old and they have a children’s tea catered to the palate of a toddler as well. The staff were pleasant and helpful. Will definitely be back. The only thing that hinders the experience was the location in the lobby, but it’s something I can overlook for future visits.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: My sister and I really enjoyed the entire afternoon tea experience! The service was great, loved the gluten free options, we left there so full!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: This was a very nice thing to do for my mom around the holidays.  The Phoenician is one of the most beautiful hotels with astonishing views across the valley.  They really do a nice job at all their events.  The afternoon tea though felt a little like an assembly line of service.  We were all seated at roughly the same times, provided the teas and sandwiches at the same time and so on.  All the sandwiches were premade and served immediately upon seating.  Well all of it was premade.  I loved our server but she rarely came back to check on us and I had to wait a long time to pay the bill.  That’s another story - was it worth it?  Maybe, but just once a season.  They also provided a small picture and tea strainer when we left.  After spending almost $400 (for 2) not sure I’d do it again.
reviews.author: HeatherW

reviews.text: Experience at the Phoenician for Afternoon Tea never fails.  I invited a friend to celebrate her 50th birthday.  She had an amazing experience.  Wanda and Natalie are THE BEST as always.
reviews.author: DonnaD

reviews.text: Afternoon tea was a real treat.  The staff was amazing and the ambience was great.  Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: MarciaK

reviews.text: The experience was lovely, but the location did not allow for a peaceful, relaxing tea. Being seated in the lobby sort of devalues a $300+ experience.
reviews.author: MSandyFeet

reviews.text: I had a lovely afternoon enjoying the tea service.  The service was friendly and attentive.  Even though I was dining alone, I wasn’t lonely.  The pianist was lovely and everything tasted so good. Thank you!!
reviews.author: JT57

reviews.text: Beautiful and elegant setting. Wait staff is amazing and always does such a good job taking care of us. Gives off a very personal experience.
reviews.author: StephanieH

reviews.text: Wanda our server was awesome as usual.  It is so good to see her every time.  The food is always wonderful and we always have such a great experience.
reviews.author: PattiK

reviews.text: Always a great experience.  One of my favorite high tea experiences.

reviews.text: We have been going to Afternoon Tea at the Phoenician for over 10 years. We will not to going anymore because the price has become outrageously expensive!  Before the pandemic prices were lower but still on the high side. Now tea for 2 people cost us a whopping  $291.00 Dollars. This is unacceptable for tea!  Unfortunately they are pricing their regular costumers out because the average person cannot afford the cost. Very disappointing!
reviews.author: DuMom

reviews.text:
We went to celebrate a birthday and it did NOT disappoint. So many positive things to say but have to start with the service - it was absolutely perfect. Super friendly and very attentive without being intrusive. The live piano music was absolutely beautiful and really added to the ambiance. The first course of tea sandwiches were all really well done, artful, and each very different and tasty. They offered second helpings of any and all types you wanted. Second course included a couple different and very fresh and tasty scones with lemon curd, strawberry jam, and Devonshire cream on the side. The final course included a good number of really flavorful and beautiful miniature desserts. There was a pretty large selection of teas. We went for the coconut cream white tea which was also a home-run.

Dining out these days is not always a satisfactory experience; but this absolutely was. In addition to the food, drink and service, it is the experience you are paying for. The Phoenician offered exceptional food and drink, exceptional service and was an overall exceptional experience. We will absolutely go back.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Truly a treat to come and celebrate at this special  place. The best service and ambiance. Delicious food and tea.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: The service and experience are always amazing.  It may be pricey but you get what you pay for.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: The service, tea, sandwiches, and pastries were impeccable and appropriately priced. Highly recommend even with children.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: I have been to the Phoenician tea many times. It was super overpriced. Not quality. Scones were biscuits not their traditional scones. We had asked for no gluten and no fish to which they forgot and replaced our plates with fish. Dessert was dry and stale. Sandwiches as well. Not impressed. Tea menu was also now a short list opposed to their normal menu with descritpions. Unfortunately will not be back.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: First time doing the afternoon tea and it was absolutely worth it! Our server was 10 out of 10 and everyone that we interacted with was so kind/pleasant.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Tea itself was lovely, as expected (I’ve been to high tea here before). However, we were seated in close proximity to a large and very noisy party so we couldn’t hear each other or the piano music. That in itself made it not worth the visit and I was disappointed. Would only visit again if we can be assured we would not be seated next to a loud group.
reviews.author: Carrie

reviews.text: Excellent afternoon tea!  The sandwiches were delicious and beautifully displayed. The scones were warm and fresh, served along with tasty curd, preserves, and clotted cream.  The tiny desserts were gorgeous and fun to eat.  The service was impeccable!  Wanda is the kindest and most thoughtful person and knew what we needed before we did.  Highly recommended!

reviews.text: I enjoyed having live piano music.  The view out the window was beautiful.  I thought the food was good, but not great. I felt like the price was high for the value.  I also did not appreciate the fact that a tip was included.  For one, it was 22% which is on the high end.  I think 15-20% would be an adequate gratuity for the level of service required for the tea. What is the point of a gratuity if it is automatically included on the bill?  The purpose of a gratuity is to compensate the wait staff for their service.  All in all, I was a bit disappointed in my afternoon tea experience.
reviews.author: AnitaM

reviews.text: The tea had no flavor and was tepid. Sandwiches were meh. The sweets were good. Venue had great ambiance and the live music was great.

reviews.text: Worth rhe money,  valet parking  was a nice touch.

reviews.text: This was my second trip here and it was just as fantastic as the first. If you think this is going to be snooty affair, it’s not. Nobody is going to chastise you for asking questions or holding your tea cup incorrectly. It’s still very elegant, relaxing and welcoming. The sandwiches are delicious and the desserts are beautiful and delicious.  I really enjoy coming here for a special treat.

reviews.text:

reviews.text: From the moment we walked in for afternoon tea the service ￼was phenomenal. we had drinks in the bar with kind and gracious service. Once seated for afternoon tea we were blown away with the attentiveness , and accommodations by Wanda , Natalie & Sabrina. I am Gluten Free and had called ahead to make sure I had a gluten free tea service , the team already knew when I sat and immediately started service without any reminder. My Niece had a beautiful kids presentation. We just had the best time and it was worth every Penny! The pianist was wonderful! We will be back for more ladies tea time!
reviews.author: DallasConnoisseur

reviews.text:
Mostly a wonderful experience.  I have a comment which I have previously stated (even though it's been a while since I attended high tea at the Phoenician).  
Being from a British background, we always serve tea from a boiling/rolling boil. Teapot preheated and then leaves steeped.  I have noticed that the black tea brought to the table and steeped is NOT strong enough.  It pours a very pale color and this is not what a black tea should be - especially once we add the milk.  I was with company and did not want to ask to be corrected.  I just don't understand why there needs to be such a weak tea served.  The server did say "allow 5 minutes to steep", but that still rendered a very weak tea.  It just wasn't appropriate at that time to complain.  This exact experience happened once before a couple of years ago.  I also would like to request (for such a high tea of very special reputation, that a decaffeinated black tea be added).  Many of us like a strong cup of black tea in the afternoons, but typically I would not want to drink caffeine after noon.  I asked for it but was told you do not have available.  Just disappointing for me to not get a steaming hot strong black tea of my choosing at your tea. I had to opt for the raspberry herbal which I did not really want. Also, I was unaware that persons could request table choice.  I brought a dear friend for her birthday and were stuck in the booth right at the back of the restaurant side.  We made the best of it, but would have loved a window table which we were told, " all tables are assigned ahead of time".   Food choices were really good - would have liked the scones to be warmed but still a little crunchy on the outside as scones should be.  Just wished it could have been a 5 star out of 5 instead of a 4.
reviews.author: Dolly

reviews.text: Afternoon Tea at the Phoenician is a special treat.  The ambiance is lovely, the service very attentive and polite.  Even the preschooler, in our little group was treated like a very special little lady.

reviews.text:
Let's start with the positive:    Wanda and Natalie, the servers who have worked Tea for so many years are still there -- and continue to be amazing.   They really make the experience.

We have been going to The Phoenician for Afternoon Tea 3-4 times annually for the last 20+ years -- and have always left having had an amazing experience, terrific service, and great food......We scaled back our visits due to the Pandemic, and haven't been in the last year or so.   We were waiting for the usually increased holiday pricing to revert back to normal pricing -- only to find out that is not happening.   And with multiple increases in the base price over the last few years, the new pricing -- with a decline in the product served -- is frankly ridiculous.

This may be the most expensive Tea (starts at $100.....and $75 for children!) offered.....   More than The Ritz or Claridges in London....... Or any other highly rated hotel or resort Tea I can find

And the food has not changed (other than the addition of a delicious lobster sandwich!)......in fact, the dessert offering has declined significantly.   Several of the dessert options were bland or even inedible (shortbread, mango tart - bring back the fruit tart!)

For 60+ previous visits, we have always left with a "wow" factor and couldn't wait for a return visit.   Sadly, we left yesterday all questioning why The Phoenician chose to fix something that was not broken -- and then charge an exorbitant amount for an inferior offering.

Alan, the pianist who worked Tea for 40+ years has retired -- he will be missed -- but the new pianist is terrific and plays recognizable favorites beautifully and at the perfect background volume throughout Tea.

We will likely return to see if they listen to recent reviews and feedback -- and more importantly to spend time with the delightful and friendly Wanda and Natalie who always make us (and, from what we can see, every guest!) feel at home.

reviews.text: This was a fantastic experience for my teen and I who love to attend afternoon teas.  Service was exceptional, we loved getting a complimentary picture together in front of a Christmas tree, and the venue is impeccable.  My teen, by her own definition, is a pickier eater than a toddler, and they allowed her to order the children's tea, which was a much better choice for her palate.  She had never been offered hot cocoa instead of tea, and she loved that option. She was even more excited when she got her own pot full of tea.  Our server and all servers and employees at the Phoenician were so welcoming and gracious.  I loved my sandwiches.  She loved hers- eating more than she usually does at tea.  My only con, I was disappointed in the scones. I couldn't eat the cranberry one, there were so many cranberries it was overwhelming. The Devonshire cream was flat tasting (usually one of my favorite parts of tea.) The dessert was plentiful and beautifully presented.  And we so enjoyed the piano player! Overall; it was a fantastic experience and one we were both glad to share.

First and foremost, the service was PHENOMENAL!! We had more than one individual attending to our every need and want!! The staff were friendly, timely with our bites, and very professional!
The scones and tea did not disappoint! The lemon curd was divine, and the cranberry scone was delicious all on its own.

The hotel is absolutely gorgeous, at least from what we were able to see in the lobby and dining area. It definitely had a holiday vibe and it was exciting to be there. The staff were super friendly and the service was superb. However, for the price we paid for a party of two, for sandwich samplers, scones, and mini desserts, we could have fed a party of four at a nice steakhouse. I understand that price point heavily depends on a person’s budget/perspective and we had a rough idea of cost prior to going, but we were left hungry an hour later after spending $261; no alcohol was ordered. We were also seated on a couch/coffee table section and not in the main dining area, which made it a little awkward to sit and eat properly.

We asked for suggestions and she based her offering on how we liked our tea or in my husbands case how he liked his coffee. We are so happy we went with her suggestion because the tea was exceptional… so much so that we ordered some for home. The finger sandwich, scones, and pastries were beyond what we were expecting. We did not leave hungry or under caffeinated. It was just a wonder time relaxing with my love while listening fantastic pianist play classical, oldies and modern music seamlessly. I will must definitely be back!!! Thank you so much for make our day a very special one.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: We brought a friend here for her birthday and everything about it was just lovely!!
reviews.author: sazcorp

reviews.text: Excellent food, excellent service, friendly staff, great ambiance.
reviews.author: SusanJ

reviews.text: I absolutely adore the tea experience at the Phoenician. Having lived in the UK, I’m very picky about afternoon tea…this is the real deal.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
Tea at the Phoenician is way at the top of my favorite things to do in life!
Everything about it but mostly always requesting and having Wanda & Natalie as our servers is simply a total joy!!!
Thank you so much!
reviews.author: BevM

reviews.text: We love going here for Tea. The food options haven't changed in years and the pianist played loudly, making everyone talk louder, making her play louder, and on and on. But it was a beautiful afternoon overall.
reviews.author: Julie

reviews.text: Very nice atmosphere with excellent service.  Beautiful view of the outside from large window.  Live piano music excellent.  Tea, drink and food spot on.  It was as close an experience to afternoon tea in London as you can get.

reviews.text: Always enjoy our time with afternoon tea!

reviews.text: Absolutely amazing as always!

reviews.author: ElisaB

reviews.text: Outstanding teas and delicious finger foods plus yummy desserts. Great service and very accommodating.
reviews.author: DrKwong

reviews.text: Sat by windows and got very warm! However, the view was lovely.  I have been to tea at the Phoenician over the last several years.  The hostesses are just wonderful.  The actual tea that is served has gotten smaller every year yet the cost keep rising.  Such a shame.  With what the cost is, patrons should get a very generous tea.
reviews.author: Nicole

reviews.text: Been going here for year. Great quality. Great service.
reviews.author: MeganC

reviews.text:
Everything was delicious, the staff was very accommodating and friendly.
A little pricey but that was expected.
reviews.author: KatShep

reviews.text: We had a great time celebrating my daughter’s birthday at Afternoon Tea!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
This is the best place for Afternoon Tea; they have a variety of teas to choose from and service is always top notch.  Wanda has been there for years and does an excellent job making you feel welcomed.   This last visit felt a little rushed; but we were uncomfortable sticking around since the ladies next to us were coughing the whole time and noisy.   

The tea sandwiches and scones are all delicious.  For birthdays they only provide two mini macaroons with a candle; they don't offer a separate smaller custom cake.  Definitely recommend the Phoenician for Afternoon Tea; no other place in Arizona does it as good as they do.  We tried them all and The worst is Arcadia Farms Cafe in old Scottsdale.
reviews.author: EvyC

reviews.text: It was beautiful and the view out the window was gorgeous. Food was delicious and despite it all being small sized finger food we were both stuffed when we left.
reviews.author: LaurenL

reviews.text: The Phoenician knows how to make High Tea special. The service is impeccable, the food the right amount, and the atmosphere suitable for celebration or quiet connection with a friend.  The pianist is delightful. We celebrated my father's mid-80s birthday and he enjoyed every minute of feeling special.  This was not our first High Tea at the Phoenician and it will not be our last.
reviews.author: Truenorthbound

reviews.text: As always, our tea at The Phoenician was wonderful.  Natalie and Wanda, who are more like friends to us than servers, attended to all our needs.  We were celebrating my granddaughter's 7th birthday, and she came away feeling like a princess.  The food, the ambience, the elegant details all contributed to a memorable afternoon, special in every way.
reviews.author: GayleS

reviews.text: Great experience to go to with friends and family. The service was exceptional
reviews.author: Anne

reviews.text: OUTSTANDING my daughter and I had a wonderful time.  Everything was perfect, the food, service we loved all of it.
reviews.author: KristineN

reviews.text: Our experience was wonderful as usual. Celebrated our daughter’s birthday and all three of us are gluten free. Everything was delicious and the service was outstanding! Thank you to Wanda and her kindness. Impressed that she remembers us each year. A special time for us!
reviews.author: DiAne

reviews.text: Over the top! Excellent and extraordinary! Extra special indeed. Wanda made it extra-special!
reviews.author: RiGj

reviews.text: This was my 2nd time at Afternoon Tea and it exceeded all expectations!! It is such a lovely way to spend an afternoon with a good friend - and you cannot beat the views!! The prices seem to have gone up, but that is true everywhere. I think the value for the money is there, so I didn’t mind!! Martha must be a mainstay there, because she was also my server on my 1st visit. Do! Not! Lose! Her!! She was amazing! Attentive without being intrusive, and so warm and friendly!! I was honored to have her again. Thank you!
reviews.author: ShannonH

reviews.text: The afternoon tea experience at the Phoenician was amazing.  Great service provided by Sabrina and the rest of the staff. Will definitely refer and going back.
reviews.author: DinnerforFour

reviews.text: We have been attending the tea for many years. The food is always very good and there is a variety of sandwiches. Wanda and Natalie are the absolute best!  Ask for them if you have a chance to go.
reviews.author: COLLEENT

reviews.text: I have been going to the Phoenician for many years and the tea had always been phenomenal. Yesterday was very disappointing, the bread on the tea sandwiches was not fresh tasted refrigerated, the scones were very dry and the desserts they honestly were not good at all. They taste like they were frozen and then thawed. This is by far my favorite place for tea but yesterday was very disappointing.   What  I can say is that the service has not changed and that it  is still phenomenal as well as the ambience. I realize everyone is struggling to get back to normal after Covid so hopefully this is not an example of future Tea.
reviews.author: Linda

reviews.text: Another great experience at The Phoenician's Afternoon Tea! Wanda and Natalie provide outstanding service! The tea, Champagne, food and experience was wonderful.....!
reviews.author: MaynardS

reviews.text: Wonderful afternoon tea!

reviews.text: Amazing afternoon tea. Met and exceeded all my expectations. Was pricey then the website describe.

reviews.text: Second time attending afternoon tea at the Phoenician and it was again… fabulous! The service is impeccable and the setting… can’t be beat. Beautiful! Piano player is lovely, champagne service is wonderful and of course the tea and offerings are exquisite!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: It was yummy, elegant and a real nice time. Wanda & Raul took great care of us. Highly recommend this fun experience.
reviews.author: SusetteB

reviews.text: It would be really nice if you all sold your Macarons. For birthdays , your hotel provides one for the birthday person.  They are delicious and we tried to purchase some from the market place but they were not available for sale.
reviews.author: Erin

reviews.text: Great but the food was not served on the traditional
reviews.author: LoveFood

reviews.text: The gluten free options were not that great this time. I contacted customer service at the Phoenician about it and they said that was unacceptable for them and that someone would be calling me to make that up to  me in some way. No one has called to make it up.
reviews.author: BrianH

reviews.text: Great ambiance, a posh, place to celebrate a special occasion without a loud fanfare. However, it is quite pricy.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: If you are not in the mood to appreciate a wonderful view, family and friends, and sunshine and if you don’t feel like exhaling during the first few notes of a of a piano solo and thanking the good Lord for your health and wide brim hats then find some local watering hole and save tea at the Phoenician for another time or leave the reservation open for someone wanting to celebrate a good life! Yes it’s expensive but should you be lucky enough to find yourself there don’t spend it criticizing, soak it all in, make a memory and giggle at the wonderful ridiculousness that is life!
reviews.author: NellyA

reviews.text: I’ve been coming to the Phoenician  for afternoon tea for years, it’s one of my favorite things to do.  This time I brought my almost 3-year-old son for some one on one time before he becomes a big brother in the next month. They do a nice job of making kids feel comfortable and adjusting to accommodate.    The little stuffed bunny as a welcome gift and toddler friendly sandwiches certainly helped.  He also loved getting his own personal pot of hot chocolate.  And just when I thought he was going to lose it someone swooped in with the check.  It was perfect timing.
reviews.author: Roberta

reviews.text: As always afternoon tea at the Phoenician is unrivaled. This luxury resort is on a level of its own. My wife enjoys this special treat. Top notch tea with champagne, finger sandwiches, scones and luxurious dessert treats. Nobody in the valley can compete with this service and product guaranteed.
reviews.author: AdamK

reviews.text: Always a lovely time here for afternoon tea.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: This was an amazing birthday present for my 14 year old granddaughter!  It was more than she dreamed about.  We will be back!
reviews.author: TeresaO

reviews.text:
There is an employee named Wanda there that is outstanding.  She remembers us and asks about relatives that were not even there! She was not at our table serving, but came over frequently so fill up glasses, ect.   She is sooooo friendly.  What an excellent employee you have in here.  

When are you bringing back the Champaign Saturdays?
reviews.author: becky

reviews.text: My family and I have been going to tea at the Phoenician for many years. Wanda is absolutely delightful and we always have had a good experience.
reviews.author: ElaineR

reviews.text: Sitting at the lower table near the bar was great for view, but was not great for conversation. The noise level is fine if you can sit proper distance from your table mate, but the low chairs are too far from each other. Otherwise, it’s too loud….that said, great piano player!
reviews.author: AZCat

reviews.text: What a special way to celebrate a friend's birthday!  The service, the food, the ambience - everything was just perfect!
reviews.author: MoniqueC

reviews.text:
The Phoenician AfternoonTea is a wonderful service that I have enjoyed many times.  The finger sandwiches are very good, and you can ask for seconds.  They offer flavored teas as well as traditional favorites English Breakfast and Darjeeling.  For an additional cost you can also purchase glasses of champagne.

Their service is always stellar.

If you valet park, the ticket will be validated.
reviews.author: Kingsfan2501

reviews.text: This was a beautiful tea, not just for Mother's Day but anytime.  The presentations were beautiful and plentiful.  The atmosphere calm and a conversation could be had amongst ourselves, table placings were nicely separated and comfortable.  Service, impeccable.  This was a proper tea that could be found in London.
reviews.author: Wolfespak

reviews.text: Wonderful girls' afternoon. Would only do once or twice a year because it is expensive for what is received.  Would do again for a special occasion.
reviews.author: better

reviews.text: Great experience - valet park and get it marked so you won't pay other than to tip. It was very peaceful and relaxing. Lobby can get a little loud at times so farthest away from the door is best. Many of the employees have worked there 10+ years and are great at their job. Alan, the pianist, has been there a long time too. Will be sure to dine at the other properties
reviews.author: Foodisgood

reviews.text: Wonderful service and delicious food.  Highly suggest pairing the champagne with the Tea.
reviews.author: BradleyB

reviews.text: We had a lovely afternoon having a 'fancy tea' with my two kids. The service and presentation were wonderful, there was a large tea selection and delicious treats.
reviews.author: CourtneyB

reviews.text: Always wonderful!  The food is excellent.  The service is perfect.  Wanda and Natalie, who have served our family for years at afternoon tea, feel like our fairy godmothers, granting our every wish and treating us like royalty--blessings, indeed.  Our visits there never fail to be very special times.
reviews.author: GayleS

reviews.text: Exquisitely appointed lobby creates a fantastic sense of ambience as you dine on delicious snacks and sip delightful tea. Highly recommend for a bit of fancy lunch.
reviews.author: MohJoe

reviews.text: Wanda is so personable.  Always so nice to see her.
reviews.author: PaulaS

reviews.text:
I've attended high tea all over the world. This is by far the most expensive tea I've paid for and by no means did the tea warrant that price tag. 
It was a nice high tea. Not in my top five however, though the price was number one.
reviews.author: ShelbyW

reviews.text: High tea was definitely an experience. This was my 3rd time but being able to celebrate with my 9 year old and my mother made it even more special. Everyone who served us was so polite and professional. The ladies really added to our overall experience. The portions are generous and delicious and the tea tastes amazing. They catered to my daughters age with the food and we had a wonderful time. We created memories as well as left feeling refreshed and pampered. Everything was delightful.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: This was the cutest and classiest tea experience. I cannot get over it and now I want to take my son for tea since I don’t have a girl!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Birthday!  The live piano and the gorgeous views were a bonus to the bottomless bubbles, comfy seating, and well spaced parties.
reviews.author: CarolM

reviews.text: The Phoenician has the BEST afternoon tea I’ve ever been to!!!  I love it!!!  Thank you Wanda!!!
reviews.author: DonnaK

reviews.text: Wanda is a real treat to have wait on you and really add to your experience. Loved the atmosphere and the piano player is magnificent!! We had a splendid afternoon celebrating my neighbor, dear friends' birthday!!
reviews.author: DeannaB

reviews.text:
Every visit to Arizona included a trip to the Phoenician for tea, but it is now priced out of my range. Nothing changed... so if you can afford $100 a person...then go for it! You won't be disappointed.

I am so sad that  I won't be able to take part in the future, as I have been here over 15 times over the years, but I enjoyed it while I could.
reviews.author: Shavilyn

reviews.text: It was extremely expensive with a charge of 180.00 for 2 people. You can only pick 2 teas. No explanation of what tea should be paired with the courses which made the experience less than special. I will never go back and don't recommend it to others.
reviews.author: Clair

reviews.text: Always a wonderful time! This time, I took my 4-year old and she absolutely adored it!
