reviews.text: Everything was wonderful!  The food was delicious as were the teas.  The staff was professional, friendly and vary accommodating!

reviews.text: such a wonderful experience that i would recommend to anyone!! great food, vibe, & overall experience! so.much.fun!
reviews.author: loams

reviews.text: The service was absolutely outstanding. Each and every one of the servers seemed delighted to be there and it made the experience that much better! The food was amazing (on the pricy side) but man was it good. Would go back again and again.
reviews.author: mmBake

reviews.text: Very cool mothers day or anniversary gift for the speial lady's in your life. Great views with delicous teas and cakes
reviews.author: Brandon

reviews.text:
A very memorable special event for us. It was a wonderful way to spend quality time with loved ones and celebrate a birthday. The guest of honor has a true gluten allergy and they accommodated her with excellent gluten free alternatives in addition to accommodating another guest that was vegan which was not requested beforehand.
Thank you to all the lovely ladies that served us with class and elegance.
reviews.author: ReginaM

reviews.text: Very disappointed with the High Tea. The tea was delicious as well as the lemon curd which can be bought at Walmart for $5 and it would last a month. The bread was so thick, you couldn’t taste what was inside. The scones were redeemable if you pile all and I mean all the lemon curd on it. The grand finale of the plates, the chocolate and coffee finger treat taste delicious if you scrape off and just eat the frosting because the cake portion was also thick and dry. I may have enjoyed it more if as soon as they brought the last dish, they wouldn’t have also brought the bill to remind me to finish quickly and get out. The view is great. So if you want to act pretentious and comparing LV’s, while not really eating the food, this is the place to go.
reviews.author: SolangeM

reviews.text: For almost $400, I expected our party of 4 to be seated at one table, not two small round tables pushed “together.” The configuration was not conducive to conversation and detracted from the overall experience. The Phoenician can do better.
reviews.author: AnneF

reviews.text: It's my go-to for special celebrations with my mom. We've been enjoying afternoon tea at the Phoenician for many years! They accommodated her dairy-free request, and it was just as tasty so she didn't feel like she missed out on any of the indulgence.

reviews.text: Food superior quality & fresh. Service very pampering and attentive. Piano music is excellent ambience! Best part is amble servings of each course.

reviews.text: Wanda, Lily & Raul always make us feel welcome and they act like we are the only ones in the room.  We look forward to our next Phoenician outing.  What an elegant property and the music, ambience and views are spectacular.

reviews.text: Christmas gift to women in family.

The bread on the finger sandwiches was wet and the scones were dry. 
We were seated on the upper floor next to the cash register. A little annoying when wait staff were there and talking. 
I’ve been to afternoon tea several times over the last few years and the food has always been exceptional. This was the worst time for the food.

reviews.author: KrisA

reviews.text: This was our 4th year to have high tea at the Phoenician. My daughter and I come for the experience, the delicious tea and food, and the ambience with lovely piano music. All of the staff is delightful and seeing Wanda every year brings us joy. This year we were seated by the doors near the piano and unfortunately that put us facing the sun for most of our tea time. I would advise anyone going not to sit in that area if you're there for the 2:30pm tea.
reviews.author: GFOSTER

reviews.text: Christmas for mom
reviews.author: Anonymous

The tea was delicious and if you opt for the champagne, our glasses were never below half. I would highly recommend!

reviews.text: We are always welcomed and remembered by the ladies. The sandwiches are always my favorite but it is all delicious! It’s a wonderful treat.

reviews.text: Delightful afternoon of tea, wonderful sandwiches, with an amazing selection of desserts. Ambiance was delightful as was the attentive service. I’ll be back.

reviews.text: As always fantastic!!! Wanda makes it a wonderful experience.

reviews.text: Christmas Tea! Super wonderful in all aspects!

reviews.text: Best afternoon tea in Phoenix! Would highly recommend.
reviews.author: BethB

reviews.text:
Wanda and her team could not have done more to make our afternoon fabulous!!!  Their service was incredible, as was the food, holiday decorating, music.....
A definite must do!
reviews.author: bananas

reviews.text: The Holiday Tea Luncheon was fabulous.  We loved the pianist so much we bought his CD.  He played so many of our favorite holiday songs & classic movie songs.  The luncheon food was so good.  My gluten free items were delicious!  The abundance of tea choices was extensive and delicious.  Definitely would return.
reviews.author: VickieC

reviews.text: Always a wonderful experience,  ut at the holidays extra special. Wanda is a wonderful server making one feel like an old friend!
reviews.author: Michar

reviews.text: Another fabulous Christmas tea! Thank you, Wanda, for making the ladies of my family feel so welcome and so special! You are a gem!
reviews.author: Azgurl4ever

reviews.text:
The atmosphere and service were nice. I was surprised we were never offered champagne as I know that’s part of the tea service. 
The food was good although the pastors were bland. 
I would recommend for special occasion only.
reviews.author: Nancy

reviews.text: The Phoenician Afternoon Tea is by far the best high tea experience I’ve ever been too. Excellent service, food, tea selections, and ambiance. Holiday tea is my favorite time of year. So festive & fun!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: I was disappointed. With all the renovations they lost the unique ambiance the tea used to have. Tables (looked like outdoor furniture) were stuffed in every corner. Food was just ok for the money spent. Wanda is by far the best server! I’ve been coming to tea for many years with my mother. Yesterday was my last time. It has lost it’s specialness.
reviews.author: JDM123456789

reviews.text:
Afternoon Tea at The Phoenician is always an exceptional delight.
Wanda and Natalie and the rest of the team make you/your party feel so welcomed from the time you arrive.
reviews.author: DonnaD

reviews.text: Such a fun tradition for my daughter’s birthday. It’s always beautiful, elegant and delicious. The experience is fantastic start to finish.
reviews.author: AudriK

reviews.text: Always wonderful. Beautiful room, lovely presentation, always superb, friendly service.  Food was delicious.
reviews.author: Annimat

reviews.text: Outstanding, as always.
reviews.author: Tina

reviews.text:
Overall everything was fantastic. Great service, delicious and abundant food. Loved the piano music accompaniment. Very much appreciated the gluten free option being both available and just as delicious as the regular fare. 
Was a tad crowded and noisy, but glad to see business is good. Perhaps a more staggered seating timetable would help. 
Loved seeing the ladies and gents that had dressed as though attending the tea was the special event it truly is. Some sort of enforced dress code would be nice though I realize most of mainstream society has ‘progressed’ past dressing appropriately for the occasion and sadly will only dress for themselves.
reviews.author: MamaB

reviews.text: Waitress was so frequently. Atmosphere was clean, relaxing and modern. Would definitely recommend this for any get together. Cannot wait to go back for the holiday tea.
reviews.author: EmilyS

reviews.text: This was a birthday tea for my daughter.  There was more than enough tea.  The presentation was nice, but not amazing.  The food was brought to us on plates by the staff.  The finger sandwiches were good.  The scones were pretty good.  There were a few desserts that were really good and the others tasted “run of the mill” and nothing that you couldn’t get somewhere else.  It would be awesome if the food that you receive was “special” and a bunch of unique flavors that you cannot find anywhere else.  Sadly that wasn’t the case.  It was still a fun time and a great experience.  The pianist was Excellent!  She was the best part of our visit.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: We've been going to afternoon tea for a few years no as mother-daughter day with several fiends and their daughters... we love WANDA! She's always amazing, but this time we could hardly hear anything as it was VERY loud...We brought a friend who's never been to tea at the Phoenician, and it certainly was not a pleasant experience for them...Any way to keep noise level down? There was a huge party next to us and there were also guests that were speaking so loudly. Definitely wasn't a good experience this time around. Food and service was top notch as usual!
reviews.author: Aisully

reviews.text: We had an amazing time at Afternoon Tea.  Everyone was incredibly nice and helpful even though it was our first time doing this. The food was delicious. The tea was phenomenal.
reviews.author: Melissa

reviews.text: Way overpriced. Felt like just having tea in a hotel lobby.  Food was just okay. Nothing special. Wouldn’t go there again for that.
reviews.author: LindaA

reviews.text: The tea room was very noisy when we went on a Wednesday. I think because there was some sort of conference or event going on that day so there was a lot of people sitting at the bar right next to the tea room (which is not separated in any way from the tea room). There was also people from the bar walking through the tea room and that created a lot of distractions and unnecessary traffic while we were trying to enjoy our afternoon tea.
reviews.author: Angel

reviews.text: Tea service area close to bar and lounge area, much too noisy - made conversation difficult and not relaxing. First course of sandwiches served before we'd had time to sit and settle, and before our tea was even served. Egg salad too oniony, ham and asparagus sandwich had no ham, scones were an unusual texture. The gold plating had worn off many of the dishes. Table small and crowded with tea and food items even with only two people. Staff was friendly and courteous, dessert course was delectable. Our tea choices were very good and served hot. Poor value for the quality of the experience.
reviews.author: CarolynS

reviews.text: It was such a wonderful experience! I felt like I was in a movie! The music and ambiance was lovely, the tea was delicious and the food was very good too! 10/10 recommend
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Wanda is the best reason to enjoy high tea at the Phoenician. Her energy is infectious and her hospitality is beyond the norm.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: My afternoon tea service was a delight! Afternoon tea at the Phoenician combines the delightful, expected traditional teas, finger sandwiches, scones, and delicate desserts, served on elegant white, and gold china, with a touch of modernity as the exclusive, chic tea salon is set to one end of the Phoenician's lobby, looking out on Camelback Mountain. The ladies attending to the guests went above, and beyond to accommodate my request for a solo table with a view, as well as provide exceptional service. They were so kind, and patient, to re-seat me within the main salon, I just can't say enough about their professionalism. The food, and teas did not disappoint, everything was fresh, and picture-perfect. The ambiance was refined with music from a live Pianist, and those incredible views of Camelback, however it never felt stuffy, quite the opposite, relaxed, and serene. The whole experience was just the sort of elegant service you'd expect from a luxury hotel, and I'd recommend it to anyone wanting to enjoy afternoon tea with all of the bells, and whistles of tea, but refined, and moderne.

reviews.text: Absolutely HORRIBLE service. They called ahead to ask if anyone had food allergies. I shared that my very young daughter has severe allergies to cashews and pistachios. They promised to accommodate. As soon as we sat down, there were pistachio macaroons on the table, and it only went down hill from there. We asked for them to bring out a plate of desserts that did not have any nuts. The server brought out a plate of desserts, sat them in front of my very young daughter with the nut allergy, and then started speaking to another woman in my party. Thank goodness I didn’t let my daughter try anything on the plate in front of her, because the server then came back and grabbed the plate, saying “oops, I’m sorry! These are actually all of the desserts that have nuts.” Mind blowing. This is a 5-star hotel, and they can’t nail down nut allergies?? If my daughter would have bitten in to anything on that plate, we would have had to administer an epi pen and call an ambulance. And this all happened after their call ahead of the reservation asking about allergies. Utter incompetence and an actual danger to anyone who has a food allergy. Stay far, far away. There are so many better options around town.

The desserts were very beautiful, but not as good tasting as they are to look at.  The tea is served in the lobby of the resort right next to the bar, so we were seated at a very low table in club chairs, which were very awkward for an elegant tea service. I was facing a large screened television with a football game the whole time. It's less than ideal and distracting for a pricey venture of tea and conversation. The Phoenician is trying to have its cake and eat it too by hosting their tea in the lobby, but it left us wanting.

reviews.text: Afternoon Tea at The Phoenician was pleasant. The pianist is outstanding and most of the food was good. However, the bread used for the chicken salad was very dry - stale and there was a scant amount of chicken salad on the small sandwich which was disappointing. This was a birthday gift to my daughter who is an avid tea drinker. You get to select one tea each and then it is served in very large, heavy tea pots which are impractical because it is difficult to drink that much tea before the water is cold. I managed 3 cups and my daughter had 4 cups. The pots arrive at the table promptly but you pour your own servings. The desserts were good and boxes To Go were provided so we enjoyed our few leftovers at home with fresh tea! Once the check was brought over and I gave my credit card to the server - that was it - no thank you for coming to Afternoon Tea - in fact the cleanup began and it was clear she wanted us gone! At $169.78 for two people it is something you might do one time. As stated, this was a birthday celebration for my daughter and we had a lovely time together so that is truly all that matters. I was disappointed that the server did not come back a say thank you or wish us a nice afternoon - the 22% tip is included in this price but I had already left an additional tip for the servers with the check...prior to the "cold treatment" at the end of the tea.

reviews.text:
We tried the afternoon tea at the Phoenician after going to a full tea at another venue a prior weekend and this was OK comparatively. I reminded the hostess I was gluten free, it was also in the reservation made two days prior, and still had to remind the servers for 2 (first and second) of the 3 courses after non-GF food had already been brought. The gluten free selection was good (scones were especially delicious) except for the final course, which was only a small and hard brownie that tasted slightly of refrigerator. The chocolate covered strawberries and macarons that were on my partner’s plate are normally naturally GF but maybe they were made differently and so weren’t included on the gluten free offering. I’m thankful they have allowed for gluten free offerings at least so those complaints are minor and wouldn’t affect people who don’t have my same issues. 

Food aside, you are literally having tea in a hotel lobby, so there’s plenty of people milling about and walking by not very far away. There’s a divider in the area that steps down into a more separated area where the music is being played that seems like it would be a nice ambiance if you are able to get a table there but if you are not able to be seated there then you are seated in the lobby. 

Overall, it wasn’t bad, a cool experience and would recommend if you were already staying at the hotel, but if you are looking for a good full tea there are better offerings in the valley at the same or a slightly lower price point.

We had a gorgeous view out of a panel of glass windows. The only thing that would have been helpful is that we didn't know where to park and ended up walking longer than necessary, but it was such a lovely day, we hardly noticed. I would definitely recommend the experience (and make sure to come hungry!).

reviews.text: As always, afternoon tea at the Phoenician was wonderful!  Natalie, Wanda, and other staff provide friendly, professional service.  And, Allen's piano music provides the perfect ambiance.

The sandwiches, champagne, lemon curd and the beautiful place settings and tea sets were all our favorites. The service was warm and inviting and very relaxing. I really appreciated how friendly and attentive the servers were. We packed up our desserts and enjoyed them the following day which was just lovely! I definitely recommend going with family or friends for an enjoyable afternoon.
reviews.author: Gfergie

reviews.text:
Lovely holiday selection but miss the eclairs!

I always love tea at the Phoenician.

reviews.text: We loved our afternoon tea at the Phoenician. This will be our new holiday tradition, already looking forward to next year!

reviews.text: Visiting from NY and we come here every year. It’s always a great experience and great food. Definitely the best afternoon tea we have been to. reviews.text: Annual Mother/Daughter Tea at the Phoenician. Excellent in every way as always, which is why we come back every year. Natalie rememberers us each time and goes above and beyond to personalize our experience.

reviews.text: It was Valentine’s Day weekend.  The hotel only had the Valentine’s Day prices which was almost double the normal.

reviews.text: This is always an expensive experience, and I know it, but it was the day after Valentine’s Day so they called it a Valentine’s Day tea and raised the price even more. Food and all was just the same as their regular tea.  NOT HAPPY!  Is the Phoenician really this desperate for money. Just don’t make your reservation close to a holiday or,you will be unpleasantly surprised by the charges.

The tea food was nice and the service was great, but the location is in the busy lobby next to the bar that has sports on TVs and the noise level was way too high.  There are way too many people walking through, and it was just not a relaxing or beautiful experience as I had hoped.
reviews.author: KristiC

reviews.text: This place is fricken ridiculous! If I could give it 6 stars, I would. I loved every savory, sweet minute of this experience. The ambiance and food and service and live pianist and food and more food... this has to be the best tea service I have ever had.
reviews.author: Ginny

reviews.text: Wonderful, Delicious and you can even request a Vegan Gluten free menu. Which I did and the scones were delicious, like cake. The sandwiches were fantastic, all veggies. There is no vegan cream though, so I cheated a little. The dessert was berries and a vegan cream. Everyone else went with the real stuff and they loved. The tea is great too. We all ordered a different tea and tasted all the teas like a wine taste. We went for my mother in laws 89th and she really felt special as they sing Happy Birthday to everyone accompanied by piano.
reviews.author: JodiH

reviews.text:
This was a lovely tea experience.  Live piano music, delicious food and good service.  As it is popular it was busy and I think they would benefit from another server or two to truly perfect the experience.   Our wait was primarily at the start of our service and did improve as we went along.
My sisters teapot had a bad chip right on the edge of the spout, and should not have been left in service.   They removed it immediately once we pointed it out.  I just feel that and the slow start weren’t a good match for the exceptional service the Phoenician is known for.
reviews.author: FrancesJ

reviews.text: Always a great time at tea!  Great food and tea!

reviews.text: Went here to celebrate a birthday. Food was great. Staff was friendly and helpful in picking out teas for the table.

reviews.text: I have gone several times and enjoy it every time. However, this time I felt rushed and I’m not sure why.

reviews.text: I love tea time at the Phoencian. The service is excellent and the hostess, Wanda is fabulous. Thank you for a great afternoon.

reviews.text: Poor quality sandwiches, desserts obviously made from frozen and pre-made ones offered by food service supply companies (you can easily find the same petit fours at Trader Joe’s and Costco’s), tea was weak and hot chocolate was watery, scones were the size of saucers but not flavorful, Devonshire cream was “off,” server was abrupt and very talkative...not impressed at all. Loved the vistas and the view, the piano was lovely but the food and drinks left us with a bad taste in our mouths. I’ve already wanted friends about the poor quality experience because the quality of the tea did *not* meet expectations.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Great afternoon to celebrate the holidays with friends.  We will continue to come back each year to see Wanda, as she has become our friend too!

Embarrassing for my guest as well.

reviews.text: I treated my special needs adult daughter and her special needs friend to this tea. No one explained the serious price hikes for the upscale champagnes offered. I didn’t have any, they sipped on a couple of glasses and our bill was $330. It was a shock. As much of a nice treat as it was, it was overpriced.
reviews.author: MADELYNT

reviews.text: Was weird when we walked up to hostess - she looked at us and said - I'll be back in a few minutes- someone in the bar needs to be seated and walked away, no greeting, and seemed hurried, noticed she didn't bring anyone back from bar. Service was not outstanding, seemed fractured. Have had afternoon tea at the Phoenician several times, this experience was not pleasant and almost twice the normal cost. Holiday decorations minimal. Will not be back for their Holiday Afternoon Tea.
reviews.author: Mstryis

reviews.text: Terribly overpriced for the experience.  The food was nothing special; the bread in the finger sandwiches was dry and the flavor of the food was bland and unexceptional. The service felt very rushed.  Definitely not worth $100, much less the $375 that we actually paid for three people.  Will not be back.
reviews.author: BellaDesign

reviews.text: Everything was pure perfection from the service and food to the beautiful hotel lobby. Tea at The Phoenician is a very special and unhurried event, and I am always sad when it ends!

reviews.text: Wonderful Holiday Tea outing with 'The Girls".  The venue is amazing and the service is exceptional.  I used to work here when I was in college and it's nice to be able to come back as a guest some 30 years later and see that none of the elegance has been lost.  It's been wonderfully updated and modernized without losing all of the charm.   Make a reservation during the holidays for this classic, timeless tradition, you won't regret it!

reviews.text: Outstanding service.  Recognized a birthday for us and also accommodated increase to our reservation which is much appreciated.   Thank you!

reviews.text:
We had afternoon tea planned to celebrate two birthdays - and when we arrived there were little cupcakes for the birthday girls and they sing to you also ! It was so special . 
The service at this resort and Tea is phenomenal . We stayed here and were just so impressed by how courteous and happy the staff all are . They are ready to help in a flash ! The food choices were catered for the vegetarians and were delicious. The servings are so generous I could barely make it through the last course of desserts! I would highly recommend this Tea for anyone looking to have a nice afternoon with friends or family- and if you’d like to feel spoiled !

reviews.text: Wanda was wonderful and made the evening very enjoyable.

reviews.text: Thanks Wanda T! You’re the best!!
reviews.author: DeniseW

reviews.text:
This was our first time at the Phoenician for high tea. We enjoyed it very much. The service was amazing from the valet and hostess to the actual tea service. They even were accommodating to my sister who has special diet needs. This was greatly appreciated! They made her feel inclusive and the rest of us were able to enjoy the full experience.  Everything was wonderful except for some of the food. The desserts were great, but the scones were very dry and doughy. I love scones so consider myself a bit of a connoisseur. None of us cared for them very much.  the variety and flavors of the sandwiches were very good, but on a couple, the bread seemed a bit stale of hard on top; like they had been sitting out for a while. 
I love tea service in general and everything was wonderful except for a few of the food items.
Thank you!
reviews.author: Tracy

reviews.text: Beautiful view of the mountains and  we sat right next to the pianist. The experience was lovely and welcoming. The food and tea was delicious.

reviews.text: Love the Phoenician for high tea! It was noisier than usual, largely due to bigger crowds (thanks Downton Abbey), but we will always be back!
reviews.author: StacyM

reviews.text: Beautiful afternoon of tea, champagne and friends! The sandwiches are so delicious, the scones and accompaniments great, as well as the desserts. For sure get the Champagne, they keep filling your glass as you enjoy piano music and the afternoon. A great revamp of the traditional tea.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Had a great time at the Afternoon Tea at The Phoenician. We love the tea from this establishment! Love the opportunity to have as many tea sandwiches, scones and pastries. This is always a great experience and one we will be doing again!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Service was good, but the food was lacking. The bread for the tea sandwiches was dry, as were the scones (they literally crumbled apart). The second issue was that it was quite warm near the windows, so much so that we were sweating. Third, I did not enjoy having afternoon tea with the bar patrons. It seemed strange to me to have  the afternoon tea venue embedded with the bar crowd. In my opinion, afternoon tea is meant to be an elegant and tranquil experience, whereas the bar is casual and fun. Both ambiances are great independently,  I just didn't think they complemented each other when blended together.
reviews.author: JacquelineR

reviews.text: Absolutely beautiful tea service! Staff is fantastic! Highly recommend!
reviews.author: kr0975

reviews.text: Very efficient staff, perfect ambiance and stunning views of the Phoenix area. Everything was perfect.

reviews.text: Afternoon tea is amazing. Location, service and food are all 5 star. Must do when in Scottsdale.

reviews.text: Perfect :)

reviews.text: My friend and I have celebrated our birthdays at this Tea for 25+ years. Always wonderful!!!

reviews.text:
Lovely venue, superb service, lovely food 
At a very reasonable price considering how well managed and set up.  Certainly recommend to anyone who wants a quiet, lovely afternoon repast.

reviews.text: Everything is great from the sandwiches to the scones to the truffles at the end.  Wanda makes the experience thoroughly enjoyable.  I never miss having Afternoon Tea at The Phoenician when I'm in Phoenix!

reviews.text: The food was absolutely outstanding.  Four courses of the best food in the valley!

reviews.text: This is our 4th year coming to the Phoenician for Afternoon Tea to celebrate my best friend’s birthday. We’ve tried other places, but nothing compares to Tea at the Phoenician. The tea is incredible, the food is delicious, and the staff are very polite and attentive. Wonderful atmosphere - beautiful remodel recently. Highly, highly recommend! The experience is worth every penny!
reviews.author: Anon

reviews.text: Always a beautiful, delicious experience. Natalie and Wanda will make sure your tea time is excellent. Highly recommended.  THE BEST afternoon tea in Phoenix. You won’t be disappointed.
reviews.author: LKKAZ

reviews.text: Tea at the Phoenician is always a delightful treat.  The food is interesting and delicious, the service attentive without being intrusive and the live piano music is a subtle background for your conversation.  The view is hard to beat as well.
reviews.author: jbhk

reviews.text: I have attended afternoon tea at the Phoenician several times and the Champagne Saturday was up to par. The staff is polite, friendly, professional and outstanding. The food was just as great as it is during tea and we were pleased beyond compare with the entire evening. We were celebrating a birthday and they made the birthday girl feel special with a lovely cupcake and candle. It was a nice reason to dress up a bit, share some lovely food and champagne and enjoy a view of the valley!
reviews.author: Charming

reviews.text: Afternoon Tea at the Phoenician is not to be missed. We went for a special occasion and I can't think of any event or restaurant environment that is more appropriate. We celebrated the end of my mom's care of my daughter in our home since she's now going to kindergarten. Breathtaking view, absolutely delicious food, options for children, took our time and were not rushed, quiet environment with live but soft music, impeccable service. Expensive for sure and we knew that. Not your average meal and well worth it.
reviews.author: LisaR

reviews.text: Tea at the Phoenician is always a special occasion!  The setting is breathtaking with a view of the mountains.  The room is beautifully appointed.  I particularly enjoy the granite wall and contemporary light fixtures. There is a wide variety of tea selections; herbal, white and black teas.  The food is incredible.  My favorite are the cranberry scones.  Great flavor and so flaky.  The desserts are too die for!  The two ladies that run the show, Nathalie and Wanda, are amazing and take the experience to the next level.  We will be back again and again!
reviews.author: DebbyK

reviews.text: Lovely tea service in a lively locale.  Perfect Sunday afternoon treat.
reviews.author: SheilaW

reviews.text: It's a bit pricey for finger sandwiches and tea, but great memories for a special occasion
reviews.author: TinaO

reviews.text: Afternoon Tea at the Phoenician is such a special treat. Wanda is the best and always makes it an amazing experience
reviews.author: JillW

reviews.text: Wanda is amazing. We see her every year for my granddaughter’s birthday. She makes the occasion even more special.
reviews.author: CindyW

reviews.text: The tea sandwiches were excellent.... the scones and pastries not so much.  Scones were dry and while pastries were pretty, they were not good.   I would think that the Phoenician would have a superb pastry chef for this event, but not so.    And while you would expect a high tea in the summer to be somewhat classy, we were seated next to very young children and some attendees attired in bathing suits and cover-ups.     Not at all the afternoon tea we had expected!
reviews.author: Mike

reviews.text: Annual girls afternoon tea.  Staff were friendly as usual.  The sandwiches, scones, and desserts matched with my memories of past years going to tea, which is always good.  The Phoenician accommodated my vegan and vegetarian friends, so they were happy too.  The vegan chocolate dessert was really good according to my friend and she was super happy with it.  We look forward to next year's gathering!
reviews.author: ducky

reviews.text: It was really a lovely experience.  You couldn't ask for more attentive service and the food was very good. There is an interesting assortment of teas and a delightful selection of finger sandwiches and pastries.  It is somewhat pricey, but well worth it when you factor in the service associates.  Wanda is wonderful!
reviews.author: MelanieWC

reviews.text: Nestled inside the lobby of the Phoenician Hotel, afternoon tea is a place to socialize with friends and family. The meal was delightful and paired well with the wide selection of teas was bite sized sandwiches, scones, and desserts. It was well worth the visit. We will be back!
reviews.author: Yukonfoodie

reviews.text: Best afternoon tea ever. Super nice servers. Great sandwiches n scones
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: High Tea at the Phoenician was a wonderful birthday treat!
reviews.author: JuliMphxaz

reviews.text: Wonderful experience. This is a real treat.The service was incredible. Wanda looked after us so well and made this experience a birthday to remember.
reviews.author: Dallas

reviews.text: The venue i s beautiful and the staff was amazing - the grounds of the hotel are lovely.  Its pricey, but its a lovely afternoon.  A must do at least once.
reviews.author: CammyJ

reviews.text: Had a lovely time!  Service was excellent and the piano music helped create a wonderful ambiance.
reviews.author: LISAS

reviews.text: Love the high tea! Food was good, but the scones were mor like biscuits. The sandwiches were delicious. The desserts looked amazing, but flat on taste. Presentation was spot on! One of my friends ordered the GF menu and it was good, except for her dessert. There’s was only one option and it was a chocolate cake with a lot of coconut and she doesn’t like coconut, so that was disappointing. Should offer more GF desserts. reviews.text: Perfect for date night or a special get together with friends.  The grounds are beautiful and the room is elegant but not fussy.  This is a fixed menu that changes weekly. Our meal included bites of ahi in pastry, fried mini lobster tails and beef wellington.  Dessert included a dark chocolate truffle and short bread.  Everything was delicious and it gave us the opportunity to taste things we wouldn't normally order.  The service is professional and attentive without being intrusive and staff is very friendly. Your champagne glass will never be empty!  If you aren't staying at the resort, bring your parking ticket for validation.

reviews.text:

This time she almost threw the food with the tings in the plates. The quality of the food is not as good as is once was, but quantity is abundant. 
I preferred when the courses were served on the stacked caddy and left in the center of the table. Also, the champagne was of lesser quality than previously.

reviews.text:
The Phoenician needs quite a bit of notice to accommodate common dietary restrictions; even though I called on a Friday for a Sunday reservation, they told me they hadn't received my information and weren't prepared to offer me a gluten-free tea. Happily, some of the servers seemed able to pull some things together- unhappily, it was mentioned "there's another gluten-free diner here and she didn't eat all her appetizers so here are what's left!". I'm just baffled how that's a statement made at a fine dining establishment; honestly, I'd rather you lie and let me think it was whipped up for me instead of getting literal leftovers. 
The tea was nice, a good selection of tasty varieties, and the pianist was faultless- engaging and contemporary without being cliche. Views are unbeatable. Our table however was a strange choice- a block cylinder to the floor with no space even for toes to go under; uncomfortable, as the choices are to straddle or approach sideways to get close enough to the table to comfortably eat. Not sure if tables are all like this but I wouldn't spend another tea sitting at one. 
Servers were all cheery and competent, though the pace of service is quite fast for tea- we were in and out in just over an hour. Hardly an expected pace for high tea, but clearly geared for max reservations.
Note, a child's price is advertised but tea is in no way catered to children; we were surprised at the lack of even a few child-friendly options, like a pb&j finger sandwich or shortbread cookies...our children picked at salmon sandwiches and brandied cherries. Seems like a major oversight for such a nice place. 
Beware a 22% (!) gratuity is added, even for small parties. I tried to flag down a server to clarify if this charge was in fact a tip as it's labelled strangely on the bill, but I couldn't get anyone in time and wound up leaving an extra 15%- far too much for being served someone else's leftovers and charged $40 per child for no child-friendly options.

reviews.text: My husband set up Afternoon Tea for me and our 18 year old daughter.  We had a truly wonderful time.  The two amazing women, that were our servers, were phenomenal.   Wanda was the one woman and I feel terrible for not catching the other woman’s name.  They made us feel completely welcome.  We never felt rushed.  We loved their kindness and the way they made us feel just so very welcome there.  The food was absolutely delicious.   We definitely did not leave feeling hungry.  My daughter asked when we could go back again.  We would love to make this an annual event, although biannual would be better!  Big time thanks to my husband for giving us this extraordinary experience.
reviews.author: RebeccaN

reviews.text: Outstanding, as always. Wanda and Laura went out of their way to ensure that we enjoyed a perfect afternoon tea experience. A delightful, ladylike treat for a special occasion or for anytime you want to feel pampered.
reviews.author: Nm4e

reviews.text: Love the Afternoon Tea! The sandwiches are declicious as are the scones. My only complaint is that I wish we were given more scones than the two we were given!! The Perrier Jouet was delicious and a well worth the upgrade. I will be back for their Holiday Tea in December.
reviews.author: MlleJ

reviews.text: Our waitress was wonderful! Great customer service
reviews.author: MirandaK

reviews.text: We go there yearly as a family tradition.  They have a file on our family and know that income with kids and their favorite sandwiches.  They make sure to make extra sandwiches so they don’t run out.  Great service and food.
reviews.author: julingc

reviews.text: We had an excellent time! Thank you so much for everything. It was very delicious and the service was great.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
I have been a regular in the tea room for years.   It was quite disappointing to me to see the newly renovated tea room.   I am a traditionalist.    I believe in the etiquette and finery of the former tea room decor.    I do not care for the china patterns either and believe it was quite a mistake to auction off all of that gorgeous, made for the Phoenician, pattern of china.     I do not believe that anything from the tea room needed to be "fixed" or "redone".    The other setting was much more intimate.   Much more formal.   

Wanda and her staff continue to be more than fabulous with customers.   The white baby grand is still there and Alan is continuing the tremendous ambience in sound.    The food continues to be amazing.   I would suggest home made lemon curd instead of out of a jar....

I will return but it will never be as special of a treat as it was before.    Marriott is the new owner - it makes me personally, sad, to see all the changes.
reviews.author: Beth

reviews.text: The staff at this hotel are amazing people. Even though we were not staying at the hotel, the staff all treated us like royalty and it is obvious these people love their jobs. The afternoon tea is a wonderful treat and experience with delicious food and a lovely atmosphere.
reviews.author: Westside

reviews.text: The newly remodeled Phoenician Resort now has very modern furniture, a large open bar with big screen TV.  Looks like every other resort in the valley.  Afternoon tea while having football on TV and within feet of their large bar is not ideal.  It is no longer a lovely experience, and obviously their target market is a much younger crowd.  No longer a good venue for Afternoon Tea.
reviews.author: Tknaz

reviews.text: Love going here for afternoon tea. Always have the incomparable Wanda who is fantastic!  Low key with soft live piano playing makes it cozy for quiet relaxing conversation.  Food presentation is wonderful.
reviews.author: Maria

reviews.text: My wife and I have been coming to afternoon tea for years  - it is truly a unique experience in Phoenix with the friendliest and most attentive staff and a most incredible array of food and tea in a relaxed but elegant setting. Highly recommended!
reviews.author: JonW

reviews.text: The Phoenician has undergone a renovation in which they modernized the lobby area and opened it up significantly. This open area that extends all the way to the lobby tea court was very noisy, especially compared to past experiences at the hotel. The tea court flows into the cocktail lounge where business people were drinking and talking loudly. At the end of the lobby a large video screen showing sports. I was disappointed in the new look, due to the crowds, the noise level and difficulty accessing the lobby tea court. We had to walk through the crowded cocktail lounge weaving between tables. The food and service were as usual, exceptional. We have been visiting the Phoenician for over a decade. We had my daughter's wedding at the hotel. But there is an entirely new atmosphere now that is less elegant and more high energy, possibly designed to attract a younger crowd.
reviews.author: DrFR

reviews.text: I absolutely love Afternoon Tea at the Phoenician! Wanda was amazing as always my friends and I like to do this once a month!
reviews.author: KenneteraD

reviews.text: Nice place for tea on a special occasion. I recommend for parties of 5 or less. We had a group of 10 and it was a bit too large for what should be more intimate.  My bad not theirs.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Attended afternoon tea with a group of friends on Saturday.  An elegant atmosphere with attentive service, live piano music, many choices of tea,  a delicious selection of finger sandwiches, scones, and pastries.  We will definitely be back!
reviews.author: EileenS

reviews.text: Always lovely.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: We were treated poorly immediately after being seated. We brought my elderly grandmother and my mother along with my two children. We were ignored and then rushed. Food quality was very poor as well. For a $200 bill I expected much higher quality. I definitely do not recommend and will never attend again.
reviews.author: Jess

reviews.text: The servers here are GREAT! So accommodating and gracious. We had High Tea to celebrate my two granddaughter's birthdays as well as what would have been my Mom and Dad's 60th Anniversary. (my Dad passed away a year ago.) The live piano music, the breath taking view of Phoenix and the lovely decor make High Tea here a wonderful experience. The staff was so kind to meet our dietary needs and the tea and sandwiches were delicious. Overall a memorable experience we hope to repeat in December for Christmas!
reviews.author: GmaryPopPins

reviews.text: Appreciate the opportunity to have multiples of any treat we liked most, but it certainly wasn't as regal a tea service as others we've experienced.
reviews.author: jmartin

reviews.text: This is our favorite special place for me and my daughters. We always try for Christmas tea and now include my oldest granddaughters. It is a family tradition.
reviews.author: AnneF

reviews.text: Bday tea with my mom was beautiful and so fun.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Best tea service in the Valley! Great ambiance, service and food. The view from the restaurant room is stunning. Staff is consistent, prompt and friendly. Good job Wanda and Natalie!
reviews.author: teacat

reviews.text: Always enjoy being at The Phoenician.  Great high tea and exceptional service.
reviews.author: MeiC

reviews.text: Afternoon tea is just not the same since the hotel remodeled.  They took the afternoon tea out of the experience.  The décor, furniture, dishware is all a modern look, which is sad because it just doesn't have the nice atmosphere, special tea dishware and furniture or English décor that it had before.  Luckily the tea, tea sandwiches, scones and desserts are still the same and delicious.  Would really like it if they kept this area the same as it was.  I think we will be looking for another afternoon tea location that truly offers the tea experience anyone is looking for.
reviews.author: Travelingfoodlovers

reviews.text: the staff were extremely attentive and friendly! they encouraged us to have fun and indulge ourselves for a super fun afternoon of tea and pastries. I’ll definitely come again!
reviews.author: AllyM

reviews.text: Excellent food and service.  Look over your check as they added in a  22% tip.  I didn’t expect the tip to be added in for a party of two.
reviews.author: Charlotte

reviews.text: Wanda is the most wonderful person!  We love her energy and enthusiasm and look forward to seeing her whenever we go for Tea!
reviews.author: WilV

reviews.text: Perfect setting--elegant space with a stunning view over the Valley. The service was good, though hurried at times when we were trying to ask for things, but they were trying to be efficient, not dismissive. I really enjoyed the food, but I'm a big fan of afternoon tea, and they were generous with offering more of everything. I ate everything they served, and the peppermint tea was wonderful.
reviews.author: JulieE

reviews.text: AMAZING!! Will be back again. The wood was amazing and the tea was very good. Well worth the money.
reviews.author: KelseyB

reviews.text: Annual afternoon tea outing.  Took two friends who hadn't been to tea before.  I called a few days early to request vegetarian options for them and they were happy to find out that dietary requests could be accommodated.  They enjoyed the experience and the yummy food.
reviews.author: ducky

reviews.text: Always the best afternoon tea in the Valley. Both food and service is always exceptional. Enjoyed the summer special available on Tuesdays and Wednesdays.
reviews.author: Izzysgarden

reviews.text: We went for our anniversary! Had a very nice time. Will go back again this winter!
reviews.author: BeaNegative

reviews.text: Our party of 4 had never experienced the High Tea at the Phoenician.   We all loved it-from the tea and food choices to the service to the atmosphere.  We would definitely recommend it to others and do it again in the future.
reviews.author: WannaBeFoodie

reviews.text: Enjoyed the new renovations and decor. Service by Wanda was as usual impeccable. The ambiance was exactly what we needed for a relaxing tea!
reviews.author: Maria

reviews.text: High tea at the Phoenician is the best! The servers were so attentive to our needs and made it a fun, comfortable and relaxing experience. My mom and my daughter both have BD's a day apart so we chose High tea to celebrate! The servers recognized their BD's with a candle lit cupcake and "Happy Birthday" being played on the piano as they presented this very special dessert! The live piano music was such a delightful addition to the entire experience! The pianist chose wonderful songs from Sound of Music, Mary Poppins as well as many other classic songs and it was the perfect back drop to a wonderful afternoon. I would highly recommend it!
reviews.author: GmaryPopPins

reviews.text: I got sick from the food
reviews.author: CAP17

reviews.text:
This was not my usual service quality I’m used to. The lady took my plate as I was signing for my check and I wasn’t done. Before she left the check she said “no rush”... we also noticed other tables had to go boxes. We were never even offered. And lastly,
Since my friend and I drove separately, we had both of our car parking receipts on the table we needed validated. The serve only did one said seemed surprised we had two.
She never came back,
I asked the hostess if she could validate it. She look dumbfounded and said “I don’t know how to do that”. If you don’t know, just say “I’ll go figure this out” and find someone who does. She did get it validated but needs to work on her customer service skills.
reviews.author: MissMegan

reviews.text: We have been here for tea many times and it is always a treat. I brought my sister here for her birthday and she loved it too. Wanda is a special person and we love seeing her each time we come. Can’t wait to return again.
reviews.author: Judie

reviews.text: It was really nice. The sandwiches could have been a little more creative though
reviews.author: Mimi

reviews.text:
Everything great except: it was 110 degrees outside. We opted for iced tea instead of hot. They only had plain iced tea. They should have several flavors.
We also had trouble getting our iced tea refilled. When it was refilled, there was no ice in it.
We waited quite a while for our check.
Service was friendly and food was good. Would not come back for $50 each. Probably would come back for the $30 special. There’s just nowhere decent in town to have tea!
reviews.author: LauraP

reviews.text: We had a birthday to celebrate, so 5 ladies did High Tea, and we had a great afternoon!  The sandwiches were way better than expected - great variety and they kept coming around with more.  Scones and lemon curd were, of course, next on the menu.  And the tea was topped off with an amazing assortment of pastries, all beautiful and yummy.  We each had our own pot of tea, and the tea choices were also plentiful.  The pianist was delightful, the service was excellent - what a fantastic way to celebrate!
reviews.author: CarefreeAnna

reviews.text: Service and scones were amazing. Gluten free bread was pretty dry
reviews.author: krisd

reviews.text: Every year as my granddaughter celebrates her birthday, we book the Phoenician Tea. Heaven!  Service always great - Wanda, we love you!
reviews.author: CindyW

reviews.text:
Overall I knew what to expect - I thought - based on prior guest involvement at the Phoenician for many years.
I selected the Premium Tea experience for my guest and me.
Piano background was lovely and added substantially to the date.

Although service was adequate, we felt abit rushed....staff profusely offering to clear dishes. 
I should NOT have felt the staff wanted us to clear out.

While the service uses lovely  modern Wedgwood china, there are no sugar cubes with tongs for tea - just loose sugar. No clotted cream at all for scones just butter, lemon curd and preserves served in common generic custard cups. 
Seems like if the resort wants to offer a fitting afternoon tea, they lack a certain level of appropriateness at present.
My napkin - while folded - was desperately wrinkled.

I am hardly a tea etiquette specialist - I am sure someone else could add many more items to my comments.
reviews.author: CathyP

reviews.text: For something new and different to do, I would recommend this to a friend, BUT ONLY at the $30 Wed/Thurs summer special price.  Its def not worth the normal $50 price tag.  Even at $30 its a stretch on getting the value's worth.  For something to do once a year, sure I'll spend the $30, but the value is not good enough to make it worth doing more than once a year.  Service was lacking for sure.  We barely saw our waitress, had to wait 35 minutes between finishing our scones and getting the dessert bites.  Other people who came in later got theirs sooner.  My tea got cold after a bit (which is expected) but must have waited at least 25 minutes or more before someone came by so I could get it re-heated.   When the resort tacks on an automatic 22% gratuity (even for a party of only 2) then of course the staff have no motivation to provide good service, because they are going to get a nice size tip regardless.  So I would recommended to a friend with all this info and then they can decide whether its worth it to them. But If I decided to do this a second time in the near future I would definitely try another place first.  Ambiance is great though.
reviews.author: NicoleB

reviews.text: The place is beautiful. However the food was not up to my expectations from my last visit. The breads were dry, the desserts were blah. The tea was delicious. Service was slow.
reviews.author: CindyW

reviews.text: Wanda and the tea team are amazing. Afternoon tea is one of my favorite experiences and best ways to treat myself and get together with my closest friends.
reviews.author: HavonaH

reviews.text: Anymore, we love the tea service as much as Natalie and Wanda.  The new room is lovely.  The food is always great.  The pianist is good, but usually rather grumpy.
reviews.author: SBXlady

reviews.text: I came here with my best friend for her first afternoon tea experience and I was not disappointed. The staff was great and we loved all the tea sandwiches. A bonus is the view and an amazing pianist setting a relaxing tone. Very great experience....definitely will be coming again!

reviews.text: Beautiful setting, friendly and attentive staff, delicious selection of food. Fun way to spend an afternoon. Will definitely return.

reviews.text:

reviews.text: an unforgettable afternoon experience. our server, Wanda has successfully kept up the english afternoon tea tradition for 18years.  and the live piano music is a plus.  well done!

reviews.text: Way overpriced for what you get.  We had far better for less at the  Beverly Hills Hotel.  The 22.5% forced gratuity on top for so-so service was an insult.  Make your folks earn your tip Phoenician!  Pretty pretentious in my book.  Definitely not worth returning.

reviews.text: Always love tea at the Phoenician! Awesome experience!

reviews.text: Service makes this place, especially Wanda.  Tea, food & bubbly are great. Nice that Tea is back in the lobby but new setting quite a bit noisier. Still a fun place for special occasions!

reviews.text: Food is tired, unoriginal, same old same old for years.  Servers talk too fast because they've been there too long and are also bored?!  TIP:  Don't fill teapot up to the top to leave room for HOT WATER refills.  Not even a Phoenician camel can drink that much tea at once.  The tea becomes cold way too fast.  Also, I've seen every guest struggle with the totally full teapot.  Amazed you haven't had more accidents or complaints.  As a 30 year valley resident, I've been to afternoon tea here at least two dozen times.  It's great for out-of-owners or people who will only go ONCE.  For the year-round foodie resident who is willing to pay for a great experience, I think it's time to update and renovate!
reviews.author: Bloom

reviews.text: What brings us back to Afternoon Tea at the Phoenician 4 or 5 times a year?  Is it the lovely new tea room away from the busy lobby?  Is it the beautifully prepared sandwiches, scones, desserts, and tea service?  Is it the background music that sets the mood from the grand piano?  Yes, it is all of these things.....but, we would have much less pleasure without Natalie and Wanda warmly greeting us and treating us like family.  It is the relationship with the people that we enjoy and will always treasure.  Thanks ladies!

reviews.text: Afternoon here was so wonderful! The hotel is beautiful and the staff was so friendly. The food was so good as was the tea. reviews.text: A lovely afternoon. My 92 yr old mother and 4 granddaughter s loved the service, ambiance, and the food. Felt pampered and our 2nd time there. Will definitely come again 😍

reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: We along with two other tables  of 4 were seated next to a large party of 10 that were very loud. It was difficult for us to visit due to the loud table and we were in a side room with them.  Poor seating management. Service was very elegant, but we had to hunt them down twice. They added an automatic 22% tip. The scones were good, however; the sandwiches and deserts varied. Tea tasted great, food ok flavor but, All was beautiful.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: With the renovations of the Phoenician, the decor is definitely more contemporary than the classic English feel that used to exist there, but the experience is just as pleasant.  Natalie and Wanda are wonderful; remembering past guests and making sure the experience is pleasant for everyone.  Allen's piano music sets the perfect mood to relax, talk with friends, and just enjoy the afternoon.  The white grand piano in the newly renovated area is beautiful.  The tea, the finger sandwiches, the scones, and the mini pastries are all both delicious and elegant to look at.  And, the view is unmatched.  I would definitely recommend afternoon tea at the Phoenician for anyone wanting the classic English tea experience and a pleasant afternoon with friends.

reviews.text: Dear friend and I had afternoon tea. Every thing was wonderful except for the noise level. It was hard for us to catch up with each other.b Nice selection of teas, good variety, excellent finger sandwiches, light scones and the wide variety of pastries was to die for! reviews.text: Unique experience highly recommended!

reviews.text:
A lovely holiday experience. Creative items ,
Excellent champagne served if you want it. 
All food was wonderful, large choice of teas and extra portions were offered. 
I try to take holiday visitors every year and they are amazed and I have not been dissapointed. Piano with nice selection of songs created a lovely atmosphere.
reviews.author: Churl

reviews.text: This was our 11th or 12th annual holiday tea with friends.  Wanda was wonderful as usual.
reviews.author: CarolL

reviews.text:
My Mom, sister and I always look forward to our annual holiday tea at the Phoenician.  We've been coming for about 20 years and while I have been to high tea literally all over the world, I have always maintained that the tea experience at the Phoenician was the absolute best.  First, the good:   Our service was great.  Wanda & Natalie have taken care of us for years and continue to be the bright spot.  As always, Alan provided excellent background music on the grand piano - (which I understand was only installed temporarily and should be there year round!)  The food was also very good.  Their cranberry scones with clotted cream are excellent.  

However, the ambiance has truly  been ruined by the new renovations!  It appears the designers have never been to an English high tea.  It has lost all its charm with a modern, country club bar vibe.  Instead of small settees, in quiet groupings, there are big hard edged tables with modern chairs.  The beautiful serving tables set with silver are gone, replaced by a hustle & bustle as the servers disappear & reappear with each course. IT NO LONGER FEELS LIKE A TEA ROOM.  With the lobby water fountain eliminated, there is no white noise and little to absorb the significant sounds of the lobby and bar activities.  Sounds just reverberated through the room.  I ended up facing a bar television the entire tea!  It depressed us all.  Given the significant cost of the Phoenician's holiday tea, we will think long and hard before we decide whether or not to continue our annual tradition, and our celebratory events at the Phoenician.  Hotel management should really revisit their decisions and bring back the English and the charm that they have destroyed.
reviews.author: ChandlerInsider

reviews.text:
12/25 2:15pm
We were seated and all began perfectly. A table of 6 adults and 1 newborn baby was subsequently seated right next to us. The baby cried nonstop. To their credit, the mother and grandmother constantly got up with the baby and walked  around or left the lobby w/ the baby. As soon as they returned to the table the screaming resumed. However, in the meanwhile, we spent over $180. for our Holiday high tea and it was ruined by a screaming infant who never should have been bought to this very expensive high tea to begin with. We Should Have Been Offered the option of being moved to a table far away from this screaming child. Or we should have had our ruined High Tea comped by the Phoenician. I am extremely disappointed and would not want to ever repeat this event. Incidentally, I tipped the server over 20%, but still feel my enjoyment of this event was ruined and the Phoenician ignored my discomfort.
reviews.author: DODGE

reviews.text: My mother and I went to holiday tea at the Phoenician to celebrate Christmas and her visiting from out of town. All of the staff we had the pleasure of interacting with were warm, welcoming, and genuine. We enjoyed the pianist and the beautiful view. The food was lovely and there was a good selection of very interesting tea blends. We hope to make this a holiday tradition.
reviews.author: ManiB

reviews.text: We had the WORST experience at the afternoon tea. I had made a reservation on 12/7 for 145pm tea on 12/17. I frequent the Phoenicians Afternoon Tea - this was my third visit if the year, and a special visit to celebrate my daughter and my friend's daughter's 9th birthday. When we arrived, we were told by the afternoon tea manager that we are signed up for the "character tea" downstairs with princesses. I did not make a reservation for a "character tea", and I had reservation confirmation to prove that it was a reservation for "afternoon tea". The manager insisted he had no space for us, no food for us. I arrived at 140pm, and 45 minutes had passed. There were several tables large enough to accommodate the 6 of us but management rudely insisted they would not seat us and told us to go down stairs. This was a special occasion and we were not willing to share a noisy 15 people banquet table. We felt like we were treated poorly, and because we had three children with us, we should sit with the "princesses". Absolutely ridiculous- I mean this IS the PHONECIAN?! Due to our relentless and persistent effort to make our daughters day special they FINALLY seated us. We were there approximately 1.5 hours - the table next to us was unoccupied the entire time. But...they insisted they were at full capacity. Liars. Unacceptable. They blamed it all on Open Table! I hope I hear back from someone with an apology for being treating like garbage! Having said this, Wanda, our server is terrific - she's been my server many, many times and she's the most pleasant person!!!
reviews.author: Aisully

reviews.text: Amazing service!  It was my Mom’s birthday celebration and they made her feel so special!  Gorgeous setting and the best service ever!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: The Afternoon tea at the Phoenician is always a delight.

reviews.text: The perfect holiday splurge! It is a lovely environment and setting!

reviews.text: Christmas tea

reviews.text: We had a delightful, yummy time at tea. It was relaxing and the setting was just perfect. Service was very well paced. I think the pricing might keep people from experiencing the joys of teatime.  That said.....the room was full so maybe I'm wrong!

reviews.text:
Was it terrible? No. Was it what I expect from a five star hotel? No. 

The refreshed lobby looks great and the holiday decor is very nice. The valet was excellent. Once inside we were greeted promptly and seated. The table setting looked lovey. The pianist was excellent. 

One of the servers took our tea order and as soon as she left the table, another server presented us with the sandwiches. This seemed premature as we did not even have the tea at our table—and it takes 5 minutes to steep. So this felt very rushed. We selected our sandwiches and sat with them until our tea arrived and steeped—probably close to 10 minutes. So staff training needs to be improved.

We were seated against the wall and more than once, kitchen staff wearing their rubber gloves, passed in front of us with plastic bins for dishes or other back of the house stuff.  It would be nice if there was another route for them to use.

The tea was very nice; we drink good tea at home. I got the darjeeling and my husband got the english breakfast. The sandwiches were okay; I took one of each, but not one of them was truly excellent or interesting. In my opinion the salmon was the best.

The scones were good as well as the cream, jam, and the lemon curd. I had a few bites of each one with the various toppings.

The sweets were rather disappointing. Admittedly at this point I was only able to sample a few. The chocolate dipped strawberry—I cut it in half because I could not eat the whole thing and I noticed that the strawberry was starting to spoil on the edge and this would not otherwise be visible with the chocolate on top. The other items were really nothing special. I took a bite of those on my plate, but did not feel tempted to finish any of them.

Overall, my impression is that the tea has large scale banquet catering feel—not the feel of a premium tea that I have experienced in other places.  But the pricing is for a high-end afternoon tea experience, especially with a built in 22% gratuity.
reviews.author: Raven

reviews.text: Every time I come into town to enjoy the weather and views in Arizona, a highlight of my trip is to visit Natalie and Wanda for their lovely afternoon tea.  The food is delicious, the ambiance is lovely, and the ladies always greet us warmly and remember our favorites.  We love the new tearoom and the view.  See you again in February!!

reviews.text: My daughter and I were on a Dad / daughter date.  This was perfect - everything from the seating to the sandwiches to the desert was delicious.  It is expensive at $75 per person, but you are not rushed, can eat as much as you would like and get the views and atmosphere of the Phoenician.

reviews.text: We have been attending the afternoon tea since its inception.  Since this year's renovation and the new pricing, I am concerned the hotel is overpricing the afternoon tea which will lead to its end. I have taken my children here since they could walk, and there is no reason for such price increases.  This is a confidential review.
reviews.author: katf

reviews.text: We really enjoyed the afternoon tea. There was a good variety of different teas and the servings were generous.
reviews.author: KristenB

reviews.text: As usual, service, food, and ambiance were impeccable- Wanda is the absolute greatest- generally loving the new aesthetics of the place, however- one glaring omission is the beautiful grande piano that graced the lobby, bar, and tea room for years, and added so much charm, elegance, and warmth to the space. It was frankly not only disappointing, but from one musician to another, devastating and insulting to see a musician’s fine instrument downgraded from a grande piano to a lacklustre, pedestrian, electronic keyboard. Alan’s talents befit the Steinway he used to play, and he deserves this instrument through which to display his craft. As do we, longstanding, local clientele (for decades!) who love, appreciate, and expect this level of musical expression and experience. No one needs to see the cords- the grande or even baby grande piano were designed for amplification in their natural design. The new space has more than enough room next to the bar to accommodate Alan’s piano. Bring it back!
reviews.author: catherinec

reviews.text: We enjoyed a wonderful time visiting and catching up.  The tea was lovely and plentiful.  The music was beautiful and we felt pampered for the afternoon!

reviews.text: Outstanding, as always!

day was very poor and even though I had made my reservation two months in advance, the sitting was  undesirable and when I talked to the manager at the beginning all she could say was "I am sorry", yet did not offer any solutions. The bill we received included 22% tip built into it which is above 20% that I pay for excellent service and on this day outside of parking and accommodation the service was also really poor.

reviews.text: Everytime I come into town from the Chicago area, my best friend and I have tea at the Phoenicien. reviews.text: Had a lovely afternoon tea at the Phoenician.  I've heard about Wanda and was lucky to have her as my server.  She is attentive, friendly and appreciates you coming there.  All the courses were delicious:  sandwiches, scones and desserts.  Great selection of teas.  Wanda will generously offer seconds for each course, so come hungry!  I usually don't like scones, but these were the best I've ever had:  tender, flaky and fresh from the oven.  The scones combined with the cream, curd and preserves - perfection!  Live pianist added a touch of elegance to the experience.  Highly recommended for a special occasion or a fun afternoon.

reviews.text: Afternoon tea here is great, but I am sure it is even better when it is in the actual tea room. Currently it is in another location because of construction. This way, if you don't like something, then you aren't wasting the food or money not eating it. The tea is great too! reviews.text: We love the Phoenician's Afternoon Tea.  We always go at Christmas time, but this time was in the summer as a special occasion for my daughter and me.  The usual tea area, which is part of the hotel lobby, is under renovation right now, so the Tea is held in the second floor of the golf club.  Although the location is not quite as grand, they do a very good job making do with the area above the golf club.  It is a lovely room with a nice view.  The service is always impeccable, and all the staff are very attentive.  The food is very nice, with delicious finger sandwiches; scones with jam, lemon curd, and Devonshire cream; and lovely desserts.  There are so many tea selections, it's hard to choose which to drink, and I love the sparkling wine/champagne option.  There is always ample food.  You will never leave hungry.  It is definitely a meal in itself.  I am very much looking forward to Christmas Tea this year, as I hope it will be in the newly renovated lobby, which is a grand and beautiful venue.  I highly recommend this Afternoon Tea as a wonderful experience not to be forgotten.

reviews.text: Delicious afternoon tea! Each course was wonderful.

reviews.text: Afternoon tea at the Phoenician has been a wonderful experience each time we have attended.  The tea sandwiches, scones with Devonshire cream, lemon curd, jam and the desserts are exquisite and wonderful, as is the tea in the teapots and the china service.  It is one of the best afternoon teas we have attended.  The atmosphere was grand and authentic.  We heard staff mention there are plans to renovate the afternoon tea location, setting and entire service and saw pictures posted in the hotel to change the service into something very modern.  We really hope the renovations will not change the grand atmosphere, ambiance, piano music, china tea and meal service.  If they are changed, we sadly, would unlikely return to the tea service in the future.

reviews.text:
Tea was great and the gluten free menu was perfect. I did not feel like I was missing out on anything. 

Friend and I upgraded to champagne as the website said there was special pricing. I asked the woman taking our tea order if there was special pricing on the champagne because we were trying to decide if we wanted it or not. She said "yes". I asked again to confirm if there was special pricing and again she said yes. Well, there was NO special pricing and we had to talk to the manager. She then basically made it feel like it was our fault and would only discount the price from $70 to $60 even though the special pricing we were under the impression of was $52. That's only during the week. (Okay, but we asked twice because we weren't sure. Employee error would normally mean- make it right). So we paid the $60 plus mandatory 30% tip. The receipt also has a place for additional tip. Be aware of this so you don't tip again. 

The Phoenician is a great place to have tea; but just know all the rules and review it all before you go. And be aware of the tipping.

reviews.text:
Beautiful location, of course, and the traditional tea is about what you would expect from a high end resort. We sat near the pianist (who's a staple and local icon) and had the window seat, which couldn't be more ideal. However, the service was nowhere near what you would expect from a high end resort such as the Phoenician. 
We ordered the royal tea service, which is the top tier tea service that comes with the Perrier Jouet. The service started off great but at some point went downhill. I tried to wave down our server about half a dozen times over about 15 minutes with no luck. When I finally stood up to go speak to her (she was at her station) she gave me a look of exasperation and told me to hold on and went to help out another table, leaving me standing there awkwardly. 
Then, she poured Gruet sparkling wine in my half filled Perrier Jouet glass. When I mentioned that we were drinking the PJ she said that they've been refilling all the glasses with the Gruet. 
This is not fine dining service. I've worked a long time in the restaurant business and am pretty surprised at the quality at the Phoenician's service. If your diners paid a higher price for better quality champagne the last thing you should be doing is pouring a cheap sparkling wine in the glass. 
Hopefully, this was just a case of a bad server or a server having an off day. I'll certainly give it a try again as everything else was on par. 
I've had afternoon tea at the Ritz and Biltmore (as well as other hotels around the country) so I may be a bit pickier than most. But I feel that if you're paying $70 plus an automatic 22% gratuity that you should be getting a better level of service. All in all, I'd still recommend it for the location, atmosphere, and views alone.
Their scones are some of the best I've had, however, and their dessert options are probably the best.

reviews.text: My husband and I moved to Phoenix in 2014 from the D.C. area and sampled teas at various hotels and we found the Phoenician's tea to be consistent and the food and service to be of high quality year over year. It's a rather large space; however, we didn't find the noise level high and conversations still felt private. The Phoenician has a brisk tea service; however, we never felt rushed.

reviews.text: My husband and I had High Tea on Christmas Day.  What a wonderful experience...the service, the setting and views, the pianist and tea were perfect.    Due to health issues we didn't have any family coming to AZ and it seemed Christmas might be sad this year.   I saw the Phoenician Tea and signed up for something to look forward to.  It was so elegant and soothing, we both enjoyed ourselves and will be back again.   Thank you to all the Phoenician employees who spent their Christmas with us, you couldn't have been more gracious.

reviews.text: We have been going there for 19 years.  It is a beautiful place to celebrate Christmas with my family.  Wanda and all of the staff are wonderful and provide such warm customer service.

reviews.text: Had heard so much about this and was disappointed that it didn't live up to it.  First  of all, we were seated at a coffee table at which we had to sit up sideways  in order to eat which was very uncomfortable.  Then got a soggy tea sandwich and another with a chicken bone in it.   Food was mediocre although the presentation was lovely.  Servers did a good job and the pianist was nice, as was the room.  However, we were overcharged, on top of an automatic 22% tip.  And even with validation, parking was $10.  So overall, not worth the close to $100 cost when all is said and done.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: The atmosphere was lovely and the food was very good. However, the tea pots were served without cozies, so the tea was cold pretty quick. Our server was great when we first got there, but then he never came back. We had to keep asking other people for the next service and for warm tea. For $82, I expected excellent service. I can go to a number of other tea houses and have high tea that is just as delicious for a third of the price - and their tea is hot!

reviews.text: I have enjoyed quite a few years at the Phoenician's High Tea. Bringing about 8 to ten ladies with  me as well. reviews.text:
Tea at the Phoenician is hands down, the best tea anywhere in the world. And...and I have enjoyed it around the world to say that honestly.
If you are fortunate enough to have Wanda, she will make the experience even more special. She is beyond the perfect person for this special time of tea. I have enjoyed it many times there and will enjoy it many more times in the months/years ahead!

reviews.text: I had planned afternoon tea for 6 during the holidays for a special occasion.  The resort itself is beautiful and the holiday decor was gorgeous.  We took lots of beautiful pictures.  The tea itself began well, however half way through, I had to flag down a waitress 3x and finally had to get up and go and get a waitress to help our table because we needed more tea.  The food was absolutely nothing special.  The scones were not fresh and very cold.  The desserts were average.  I asked the waitress what the difference between the Christmas Tea and Regular Tea was and she said..."Oh nothing really - we just change out one dessert."  I thought - WOW...and charge $20 more per person.  For the outrageous price for afternoon tea- about $100 per person - the service was quite awful and food not worth it.  The black current tea was very good.

reviews.text:
The tea is served in too large a pot.  Because of this it becomes lukewarm and unpleasant long before you are done eating.  Solution - get effective (i.e. thermal) teacosies or fill tea pots 2/3 full and off additional hot water 1/2 way through the meal.  

Additional - scones should be fresher, or at least slightly warmed.  Refrigerated temperature is unappetizing for scones.

reviews.text: It is always relaxing and enjoyable to have high tea at the Phoenician and pamper my daughter on her 27th birthday, we both dream of days gone by when we go there. The server was a little quicky but efficent and attentive.   We walk around to get cash from the atm and stopped at the ice cream shop to purchase some ice for our left over desserts and she just gave us the ice.   It was a pleasant experience and we will continue to celebrate her birthday at this location.

reviews.text: We came here to celebrate my 30th birthday. They took such great care of us. Our glasses and plates were never empty and they made us feel so special.

reviews.text: As always, Wanda and Natalie were amazing. They show such care to all their customers and really take the time to explain each course along the way.
