reviews.author: dlkap1

reviews.text: Afternoon tea at the Phoenician is elegant, relaxing, and thoroughly enjoyable.  If you are looking for a traditional English tea experience this is it.
reviews.author: Broadway

reviews.text:
The staff at The Phoenician afternoon tea are world class, particularly Wanda and Natalie. These ladies, along with the other staff, go above and beyond to make sure the tea experience is everything you expect and more, yet are discreet, and have done so for many years. 

The culinary team behind the amazing, yummy tea sandwiches, scones and desserts should be applauded also. They have consistently been providing delicious afternoon tea as long as I have been dining here, nearly 20 years. 

Whether you are a hotel guest, secret foodie, tourist or local Phoenician looking for a quiet, elegant, unpretentious experience, afternoon tea at The Phoenician is not to be missed. It is a must on my Phoenix list each time I am in the area and exceeds (yes, really!) every other hotel tea I have attended, including those in Europe and Australia.
reviews.author: AllisonB

reviews.text: Afternoon Tea proved a perfect place to entertain an honored guest from Korea. Really a lovely setting and impeccable service. Of course, the food, teas and champagne were all of the highest quality. Delighted my guests  - was really outstanding - a fun afternoon.

reviews.text: Beautiful ambiance , lovely company, excellent service. Highly disappointed in the tea sandwiches, mayonnaise overtones were excessive , bland, and nothing special at all. Scones are decent. For 42$ a plate I expected more. The desserts are delicious but still underwhelming experience. I won't go back.

reviews.text: It was wonderful. This is my favorite place for lunch with girls. Excellent service without pushing. I felt I was a queen. I definitely will be back. One thing I would like to suggest is to extend for 30 min. Longer. Thank you again.

reviews.text: Wow!  Amazing experience!  It was my moms birthday and my kids and I took her to a 'fancy tea party' at the Phoenician.  The wait staff treated my little ones like princesses and could tell they were purposefully being patient and kind even in such a swanky place, we felt very welcome.  Then there was the food!  Bottomless tea, sandwitches, scones and pastries that were to die for.  The value was fantastic as they offer discounted prices Monday- Friday's in the summer.  Would highly recommend it!

reviews.text: The Afternoon Tea at the Phoenician was a special experience for our 33rd anniversary.  The service was exceptional and the choices of teas, finger foods, scones, desserts were "over the top".  We couldn't eat it all, but they let us take home what we couldn't eat. reviews.text: We have afternoon tea at The Phoenician every time I come to town from Chicago.  It is a wonderful afternoon to spend with a friend and feel special.  Aside from the great tea and treats, Wanda and Natalie are the reason that we come back over and over.  Love you ladies!
reviews.author: SBXlady

reviews.text: Everyone was friendly and service was great.  It was a wonderfully relaxing afternoon with soft piano music and delicious food.
reviews.author: TOng

reviews.text: The scones and desserts were the best ones I've had at an afternoon tea in the Valley. That said, the ambience was simply not fitting for a classic afternoon tea. There was a lot of noise and activity, and the service felt somewhat rushed. I was meeting a friend, who is a fellow tea and dessert lover, to catch up after some time. I felt that our attentions were constantly disrupted from our meal and each other, whether by the servers or just the amount of activity occurring around us. The other afternoon teas I have been to were much quieter, more relaxed, and more private. I suppose I expected the same sort of ambience here, which would have been much more conducive to some meaningful conversation. So if you attend tea here, be sure to understand that the lobby tea court truly reflects its name: it's as busy as a typical hotel lobby. I would recommend going here if you simply want to enjoy some good tea and desserts but not if you're trying to get some good conversation in.
reviews.author: zoytron

reviews.text: The sandwiches and scones were amazing. They were very generous with offering seconds.  Overall it was a great experience.

reviews.text: Natalie made the experience special! We were celebrating my friend's birthday and the warm, friendly service we received was very appreciated! The tea selection includes herbal, white, green and traditional black. The food is delicious and plentiful. We ate and ate and then ate some more! The finger sandwiches, scones and pastries were fantastic. I highly recommend the Royal High Tea which includes champagne. We enjoyed the pianist playing in the background. My friend is from England and she enjoyed reminiscing about home while we filled ourselves on,  as she said,  "Proper tea!"

reviews.text: My best friend and I had a great afternoon at the Phoenician.  Natalie was gracious as always and her recommendation for tea selection was perfect.

We generally do the champagne, also, however the last time the waitress charged for the most expensive brand without asking  if that was our choice.   Very expensive in the first place, so was unhappy but didn't want to make a scene in front of my guest, so didn't say anything.

reviews.text:
One of the best afternoon teas I have ever had. The finger sandwiches were delicious and the presentation was colorful and artful. Somebody had given them some thought.
And they offered seconds and thirds.
The second course were scones. The third were mini desserts such as chocolate dipped strawberries, fruit tarts, mango mousse, eclair etc. everything was good, not too sweet.
My husband had the Royal Tea which includes champagne and it was not just 1 glass. They kept refilling it.
Yes, it's kind of expensive but everything is first class including the tea service they use. You get your money's worth.

reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: We chose Afternoon Tea for my daughter's 8th birthday. We had a fabulous time! The staff was friendly and cheerful, the food was delicious, and the ambiance was amazing! They presented my daughter and her friends with sparkling cider in fluted glasses and they loved it! What a nice touch. The pianist played happy birthday and the staff sung to my daughter. It was a wonderful day and we cannot wait to go back.
reviews.author: BLS22

reviews.text: Amazing time celebrating a family birthday. Such a wonderful experience.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Brought my mother & grandmother here for afternoon tea a few years ago and it was amazing!  The food was so delicious, service was impeccable and the views were beautiful. They were getting ready to start a renovation and I haven't been there since so I'm anxious to return to see it now!
reviews.author: ouishbug

reviews.text:
The tea service is held in a section off the lobby with a views of the terrace and the skyline beyond it.  Aside from the pianist playing in the background,  the noise level is low occasionally broken by laughter. The atmosphere was relaxed and elegant but not stuffy. Service was very attentive in spite of several large parties in attendance.  There is a variety teas from which to select.  The sandwiches are plentiful and filling.  The scones were cranberry and buttermilk and came with clotted cream, lemon curd and raspberry preserves. The dessert pastries included eclairs (my favorites), shortbread cookies, little cakes and great little cakes topped with mango mousse. The special touch is the champagne.  

I come here for the high tea for special occasions including birthdays but today I just wanted to feel pampered and relaxed.  The servers, Wanda and Natalie did just that.
reviews.author: eatwelloften

reviews.text: The Phoenician is continuing the elegant tradition of an English tea. The ambiance was impressive, as well as, the place settings. The live piano music was soothing and relaxing. All three courses were delicious, fresh, and creative. The server, Natalie, was personable and attentive and went out of her way to pack up the extra leftovers for us to bring home. Recommend the relaxed and much less crowded atmosphere of the midweek tea. Recommend this experience for any occasion.
reviews.author: DarG

reviews.text: I can't tell you how much we enjoyed afternoon tea.  We were treated so well and the offerings were delicious.  This is a great experience for a special occasion.
reviews.author: wadestravels

reviews.text: High tea at it's best. It hasn't changed in decades and that's a good thing. Perfect event to share with a good friend or daughter!
reviews.author: KayS

reviews.text: I took my wife here for a special 25th anniversary and everything was as perfect as can be.  It was like being transported back into time to Downton Abbey for English Tea.  We sampled everything they had and it was all wonderful.   It is definitely one of the best dining experiences in the Phoenix area or anywhere for that matter.  We will most certainly return.
reviews.author: TopGun

reviews.text: Imagine being surrounded by soft earth tones, supported by a comfy upright dining chair, unfolding a Frette linen napkin and the table graced with bone china. The champaign twinkles as the sun dances through the cut crystal. Wanda and Natalie attend to you with ease and utmost courtesy. Plates are filled, tea pots warmed and there is plenty to champaign to sip.  Various Tea sandwiches delight the pallet and ask for seconds of your favorites. Layer scones with your choice of 3 rich condiments and delight the eye with fanciful sweet treats. Conversation flows as the pianist streams light tunes. You relax, taste and embrace the moments without realizing 2 1/2 hours past. Take in the sweeping views one more time and sigh as you rise from the table. Make a reservation. Breathe it in and enjoy.
reviews.author: Cathy

reviews.text:
Not a stranger to the traditional English afternoon tea, I was delighted to learn that the hotel I've been coming to for over a decade is known for the best Afternoon Tea in Scottsdale! 

We arrived and were seated immediately. The table was beautifully appointed with everything you would need and the menu was perfect in range. 

What different about this afternoon tea that you will not find in England are the unlimited sandwiches, champagne & fancies. 

4 out of the 6 sandwich options were very tasty to me, I don't prefer beef or fish so although they were palatable, just not my taste. 

The tea www very good, I opted for a white tea. 

The fancies were good, not the best I've had. The chocolate was my favorite & I splurged on several. 

Overall, great atmosphere, great service (keeping in mind a 22% gratuity is already added automatically...not my favorite thing) and great experience. 

Really enjoyed the time we spent here, great afternoon with great friends & tea! 

Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Vegasgirl

reviews.text: We had afternoon tea on Christmas Day and it was wonderful from start to finish. We were not rushed one bit.  Two of us ordered the tea with champagne and two opted just for the tea. We were served tea sandwiches first, six different choices and these were offered again maybe 20 minutes later. We also each had our choice of tea which was served in a beautiful teapot.  The next course included two types of scones with jams and butter.  They were delicious. The last course included delicious desserts, again a nice variety.  All the time there was a gentleman playing the piano, not too loud to interrupt conversation. We spent two hours at tea and it was a wonderful way to spend Chrustmas afternoon
reviews.author: Aubbie

reviews.text: We go every year to start our Christmas celebration. Our server, Wanda, is the best :-)  She remembers us and makes us feel like family coming to her home. We always get the sparkling wine, as well as the tea. The china is stunning, just like the decorations. Our favorite course is the first one, finger sandwiches. The scones are just average and an aquired taste. The desserts have no taste, but by then we are full anyway.
reviews.author: Char

reviews.text: My sister and I went to the Phoenician for our second afternoon tea....this time to enjoy Christmas tea.  The décor for the holidays was lovely and although it had been six months since our last tea, our server recognized us.  The food, which is all made on property, was wonderful from the sandwiches to the scones to the desserts!  We look forward to enjoying tea at the Phoenician again in 2016!
reviews.author: JennPhoenx14

reviews.text:
I took my mother to the Afternoon Tea at the Phoenician to celebrate her 87th birthday.  The resort was beautifully decorated for the holidays, the food was delicious, but the service was disappointing. I called the resort to share my concerns and no one returned my call. I also sent two emails through their automated system and never received any response. 

Service issues:
1. The hostess was very unfriendly, which was surprising for a resort with such high standards.
2. I requested a table in the piano area, since my mother loves piano music but is hard of hearing. The hostess refused to put us at a table in that area as she said the tables in that area weren't set for a party of 3.  
3. Our waitress served us a glass of champagne (as if it was complimentary) and then added the cost of the champagne (over $20/glass) to the ticket.
reviews.author: Samaz

reviews.text:
Four of us enjoyed a holiday tea at the Phoenician, as we have each Christmastime for 20 years. The food is lovely (my favorite are the scones and Devonshire cream but everything is so tasty!) and the presentation is even more so. The tea room is decorated lavishly and tasteful for the holidays, with an abundance of cream-colored poinsettias and Christmas trees. A pianist entertains with carols and songs, but at just the right volume.  The service is amazing--attentive and friendly.  Special thanks to Wanda for making us feel like family.
Christmas tea at the Phoenician is not to be missed!
reviews.author: Mrchicobig

reviews.text: I have been to The Phoenician for High Tea many times and every time it is more magical than the  last!  I especially love Wanda who serves my tea each time I am there! She is awesome! She makes the experience most enjoyable and more magical! I highly, highly recommend doing High Tea at The Phoenician and ask for Wanda!!
reviews.author: LKarlowicz

reviews.text:
The atmosphere was beautiful and made for a very special day.  I had a party of 6 and had to call the manager about our table service.  Apparently our server was sent on her lunch break during our tea and the staff did not have anyone assigned to us in her absence.  The manager apologized and was very nice about the situation, however we were left at our table for over 30 minutes with no service.  This would not deter me from coming again....I believe it was a simple oversight.  Our waitress was very sweet.

The food was very good but not outstanding.  We really enjoyed the sandwiches, tea and scones.  The desserts were not that great.  We felt the price was really, really expensive - for the food that was served.

Overall, it was a lovely afternoon and we really enjoyed the experience.
reviews.author: Candycane465

reviews.text:
I had high tea with my adult daughter, my mother and my grandmother in December. The Phoenician is beautiful, the table setting was a delight and the service was beyond compare. 
We had tea on a Thursday. We used the valet parking which was a big help with my elderly grandmother. They originally  had us set up on couches and chairs but quickly moved us to a table at our request. The service was amazing. The ladies who served us were very sweet and genuine and offered to take pictures without us asking. This was a special occasion for us so I didn't mind paying the price (it was $67 per person). For those of you who think high tea might be too high falutin, give it a chance. It was not a "snobby" experience at all, no one was dressed up, and the staff make you feel right at home.
reviews.author: Megan

reviews.text: The lovely setting and delicious food and teas are only a fraction of the draw to tea at The Phoenician.  The friendly and attentive service from Wanda and Natalie keep bringing us back each year over and over.
reviews.author: SBXlady

reviews.text: The server Wanda is absolutely amazing and friendly.  Make sure you ask her to take care of you is possible.  The other servers are amazing too!
reviews.author: Asianfoodie

reviews.text:
High Tea food and service are exceptional.  I do wish something could be done to provide more privacy from the lobby environment while having tea.  

The noise and passers by are a distraction to an otherwise outstanding experience.
reviews.author: SueS

reviews.text: Not only was this the only afternoon tea where the food was unlimited, but the food was the most delicious tea food I've ever tasted. What made the entire experience wonderful was our server, Wanda, from NYC. She was an excellent server and has the best personality. The meal alone was worth our chat with her. Run...don't walk there!!!
reviews.author: richshoe

reviews.text: One of the best afternoon tea experiences I've had.
reviews.author: JD505

reviews.text: Sitting at afternoon tea at the Phoenician is like a mini holiday to Bermuda or England. The two women working there were infectiously happy and friendly. The food was as beautiful as it was delicious and the tea area had a gorgeous view. Plan to stay, indulge and enjoy for more than an hour; you won't want to leave!
reviews.author: Flyingfoodie

reviews.text: Excellent food.  Even more exceptional service.  Memorable experience.
reviews.author: Purvi

reviews.text: The tea was delightful.  The wait staff were outstanding.  They could not have been more pleasant and attentive.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: My daughter, me and granddaughter make afternoon tea an annual event which is handed down tradition. Can't think of a more lasting legacy. Very elegant and special each year.
reviews.author: CindyW

reviews.text: I took my mother to Tea Time for her 60th Birthday and I have to say you made it memorable. We had Wanda as one of our servers and I have to say what a delight she is. I can't wait to go back. My mother goes there more than I but I have to say that I am forever hooked. In love. Thank you to the Phoenician for making our time there wonderful.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: The English Tea service at the Phoenician was a very pleasant experience.  The room where the tea was held was very cozy, comfortable, and well-appointed.  The ladies that served us were kind and provided very good service.  Although we enjoyed the experience as a whole, the one negative that we found was that for the price (we paid $70 each) there was not much in the way of food.  Yes, the Veuve Cliquot champagne was limitless, but really, how much can you drink.  We were given the expected finger sandwiches, which were tasty, however, they only ask you twice if you want sandwiches.  After that they came around and asked us if we were ready for our second course, which was the two scones we were served.  We all felt as if we had been put on a food limit.  The scones were just okay and there was not a selection you could choose from; there was one plain and one cranberry.  That's it.  The deserts were good as well, but again, not much for the price.  I would recommend the Tea for an overall experience; however, I would not recommend the $70 service we chose because it is the same as less expensive tea services, minus the champage.  I enjoyed the full experience, but if you go, be prepared to leave hungry.
reviews.author: Mydinningexperiences15

reviews.text:
My family and friends love going to afternoon tea and do so every couple of months, especially during the holidays.  Wanda always takes care of us and makes our experience so memorable we don't want to leave.  She anticipates our needs before we do!!  She is a 
GEM!!  Would recommend everyone experience this.
reviews.author: maria968

reviews.text: The setting is gorgeous. The background piano was non-intrusive, but gave a charming atmosphere. Great view. Food was delicious. Servers were attentive just the right amount. One or more can enjoy tea. Table was set beautifully and the napkin was the most elegant I've ever used that I can recall (I've had tea at the Ritz, Brown Palace, Browns in London . . .). I would definitely do this tea again. Other diners appeared to be enjoying themselves as well.
reviews.author: NLOpenTable

reviews.text: Delightful from start to finish.  Fine selection of leaf teas.  The food was truly excellent and exactly what one would expect at Afternoon Tea.  Salmon, Egg Salad, and Cucumber finger sandwiches, scones and pastries, and multiple rounds of savories.  And The Grand Royale Tea includes unlimited Veuve Clicquot.  Truly exceptional.  But for our Tea, the service out shined everything else.  Wanda and Natalie were perfect throughout the experience and made the event a lasting memory.
reviews.author: SamandLinda

reviews.text: This classic experience is a true gem. Unlimited servings will leave you over-stuffed if you're not careful. Service is exemplary.  I've been celebrating my birthday here for 20 years, and have no plans for change. Treat yourself now and thank me later.
reviews.author: Kris

reviews.text: Relaxing setting with lovely piano music. Fantastic service. Everything I look for in tea service.  Food was wonderful.  The only criticism would be garlic flavored spread overpowered other ingredients in asparagus sandwich (it was still delicious).
reviews.author: dmac

reviews.text: Servers were extremely pleasant and prompt, however, they kept serving in-between my mother and I. There were only 2 of us at our table positioned on one side as that was how the seats were set up. More than 75% of the time the server came between my mother & my conversation so we had to stop. The teapot was very heavy for my mother to pour so I poured for her. Do the servers take this into consideration? Scones were of poor quality but the sandwiches and desserts were very good. Especially the sandwich with the asparagus on it. The atmosphere and table setting was very nice. The piano player was a nice touch.
reviews.author: JaneW

reviews.text: My Bridal Shower! The perfect location to celebrate.
reviews.author: AnnaS

reviews.text: I went with my bff and we enjoyed a lot of the food, the wine, and the view. Both of us came from DC and we used to have afternoon tea together a lot and it's such a great surprise that we found a fun and nice place to restart our tradition. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Randa

reviews.text: Tea should be served in smaller pots in order to let customer try more than one tea, and also in the interest of keeping it hot!  Scones were a bit dry, but all other courses were excellent.  Our server Wanda was amazing.  I took my granddaughter to her first tea, and Wanda helped make it a wonderful experience for her.
reviews.author: Mimi

reviews.text: A very special high tea - elegant atmosphere, superb service, delicious food selection, all accompanied by light piano playing in the background. Pricey, but worth the experience for a special occasion.
reviews.author: happydiner

reviews.text: As always, High Tea at The Phoenician Resort was a lovely affair. I have been there many times and the service and high quality have always remained the same. The excellent service received is in large part to two wonderful ladies Wanda and Natalie who are long time employees of The Phoenician and who definitely understand the meaning of customer service. These two ladies make you feel welcome and at home. They are knowledgeable about the menu and the teas and they are very attentive but not over attentive. I saw this time that they had a couple of new staff members on the team and were working very hard at training them properly. I have traveled around the world and this is the one place where I have had High Tea more than any other. I have gone there just because or for special occasions like my 50th birthday. So if you are in the Phoenix/Scottsdale area and would like a lovely afternoon treat, go see Wanda and Natalie at The Phoenician High Tea.
reviews.author: dlkap1

reviews.text:
We celebrated my Mother's birthday at the Afternoon Tea at the Phoenician.  We have had afternoon tea at several locations in Phoenix/Scottsdale and I have to see that this was the best!
The setting is just off the main lobby and the seatings have plenty of room.  The servers are knowledgeable, friendly and attentive.
The Phoenician offers many tea options, some with caffeine and non-caffinated.  The teas were delicious.
The first course were tea sandwiches.....all of the food is prepared right at the Phoenician......we had chicken salad, egg salad, asparagus, salmon and cucumber.  The second course were two scones....also delicious!  The desserts were too numerous to mention....however, they included shortbread, chocolate dipped strawberries, chocolate and a mini fruit tarte.
We will definitely be returning to the Phoenician for afternoon tea!
reviews.author: JennPhoenx14

reviews.text: This afternoon tea was one of the best I've had.  The tea selection was great as were all the accompaniments.  Service was first class and Wanda our server was great!!  Thanks for a wonderful mother-daughter afternoon; we'll be back.
reviews.author: Shorty

reviews.text: upon entry we were asked if we wanted champagne before we sat down and were able to read the menu. Was very disappointed and shocked with the price when we received the bill at over $200 for three people! People need to be told how much extra the champagne is, especially like myself who was driving and didn't have much. Loved the tea layout and the gentleman playing the piano.
reviews.author: Julie

reviews.text: My teen daughter and I are "regulars" at a afternoon tea at the Phoenician.  The first time we went it was for a special occasion.  It was such a wonderful experience through and through from the food to the service to the ambiance.  It was also a great way for us to decompress and spend quality time together.   About a year ago my husband asked if he could join us.  He enjoyed it so much that our mother-daughter tea time is now family tea time.  Our daughter has a severe peanut and tree nut allergy.  The Phoenician always goes out of their way to accommodate her allergies without compromising our experience allowing her to enjoy afternoon tea.  We truly appreciate their hospitality.  Thank you.
reviews.author: seaboardbc

reviews.text: Natalie was exceptional.   Friendly, personable, professional, efficient and gracious.   Food was phenomenal.   Ambience with pianist, furniture, china - etc was superb.  We will be back again and again.
reviews.author: Beth

reviews.text: As a birthday treat we went to have tea. Be prepared as they serve 3 courses. Finger sandwiches, scones and desert.  They are generous and let u have as much as you would like. The tea is amazibg and they have a great selection .
reviews.author: Mara

reviews.text: Sandwiches were delicious, server was lovely but a bit robotic.  Scones were a true disapointment, dry and lacking flavor.  Dairy free needs of one of our group were lovely (as was her scone).  Perhaps order dairy or gluten free for your next visit.  Will go back,  it it will be in another 5-10 years, for the price not something we will do routinely.
reviews.author: TriLamb

reviews.text: We loved the food, presentation, atmosphere and most of all the pianist's styling.  We sat right next to the piano and were able to maintain a conversation at normal levels with a lovely musical background.  Most impressive!!!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: I have never been disappointed with Afternoon Tea at The Phoenician.  The soft piano music, the large windows with the gorgeous views helps one to relax quite well & enjoy the moment.  I don't go to tea often but this resort is my favorite.  Lots of fond memories.  The service was genuine.  Many thanks to the chefs that put so much love & creativity into the food they serve.
reviews.author: CathyG

reviews.text: I took my mom here for Mother's Day and it was such a treat!  We've been to other tea rooms that are a little more intimate, but overall we had a great experience.  The tea room is basically in the lobby so the noise level was higher than I would have liked, but again, we still had a lovely time. Food and service was great!
reviews.author: CMontgomery

reviews.text: I go there whenever I can. I love the ambiance and the service is amazing. The food is great and I had the new chocolate coconut tea and it was delightful!
reviews.author: MariaL

reviews.text:
Tea at the Phoenician is thoroughly enjoyable in all aspect.
Food and Service are 5-Stars
Scenic view adds to the comfortable ambiance
reviews.author: 6forDinner

reviews.text: Have been here a few times now with friends and family from London and all enjoy. They have a good selection of teas. The finger sandwiches are nice. The scones and cakes are just right with the amazing lemon curd, Devonshire cream and berry compote. The views are spectacular and the Phoenician is so beautiful.  A really fun place to come, relax and enjoy a very nice afternoon tea.
reviews.author: Bouchon

reviews.text: Lovely food. The waitress seemed to be serving everyone and seemed in a rush. Apart from that it was excellent.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: We always enjoy afternoon tea at the Phoenician.  This time our guests were members of my afternoon tea group from Los Angeles.  We all agreed that the food, service and ambience at the Phoenician is the best!  It definitely sets the standard for excellence.  Thank you, Wanda, for another memorable afternoon tea!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
I was worried, since I was famished when we arrived (we'd had a late breakfast and skipped lunch) that I'd need to stop for something to eat after paying nearly $50 (including imposed 22% gratuity) for High Tea.

Not so!

The loose leaf tea was served in one large pot per person.  We were given the choice of 5 delicious sandwiches (2"x1" was the smallest) and graciously offered one of each if we were having trouble deciding.  Our non-pompous server had impeccable manners and made us all feel at ease.  We were offered another round of sandwiches.  Two tender scones plus toppings were next.  By the time the petit fours came around, we weren't starving anymore and so we didn't feel the need to scarf down one of each.  They were offered a second time though and we had more of our favorites.  The petit fours were fresh and lovely like everything else.

Loved it.
reviews.author: HardtoPlease

reviews.text: The service was excellent and the tea was wonderful! A must for any guest!
reviews.author: traveler

reviews.text: Afternoon tea at the Phoenician with Wanda the wonder waitress was fabulous as usual!  Great food, service and ambience!  Our guest said she felt like a queen!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Perfect  afternoon tea except the scones were very dry.  We had to load them up with cream and jam to get them down.  I have had tea at the Phoenican at least ten times before and this is the first time I have had any  complaints about the quality of the food.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: The food was fabulous with a nice variety of finger sandwiches, scones and desserts.  The service from Wanda was absolutely the best!  A wonderful way to treat yourself and others.   Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Bar none, tea at The Phonecian is the best - anywhere.  The food was exceptional and the service impeccable.  Each course is described and served to you by two of the most friendly and professional women who clearly love making guests feel special. The live pianist along with the beautiful china and linens makes the ambiance perfect. I can't say enough good things about our experience. We will be back!
reviews.author: LaurenT

reviews.text: Natalie and Wanda are the best!  My best friend and I visit tea at the Phoenician everytime I visit town.  We love the atmosphere, the food, the tea, the piano, and the view.  But, our favorite is now the two wonderful servers who remember us with a warm greeting and hug every visit.  We are already planning our visits in April and June.  Can't wait!!
reviews.author: SBXlady

reviews.text: a fitting and fulfilling afternoon with a most special friend from out of State!
reviews.author: grateful

reviews.text: The high tea experience at the Phoenician is outstanding. If u r lucky enough to have Wanda as ur attendant U r truly blessed. Wanda makes a great experience even more wonderful. Thanks, Wanda.
reviews.author: Mesadiners

reviews.text: I've been to afternoon tea at the Phoenician several times since moving to Phoenix. It's one of my favorite treats to share with new friends.
reviews.author: Zybrena

reviews.text: My sisters and I had a lovely time at Tea. The service was impeccable and the food delicious and plentiful.
reviews.author: dlb9239

reviews.text: Tasty sandwiches and desserts, in abundance.   Very professional service which was also personal and polite.  Perfect for a special occasion.
reviews.author: Milly2121

reviews.text: Thank you to Wanda and Natalie for making our New Years Day afternoon tea a very enjoyable experience for our party of 9. You always make us feel welcome and appreciated and your service is exceptional. The atmosphere is light, bright and happy. Table settings are welcoming yet elegant. The live piano music is muted, rich and comforting. Tea selections are plentiful, sandwiches all have distinctive flavors, scones are to die for and the assorted pastries are to be slowly savored. Bottomless champaign and tea refills add to the exceptional value. We allow 3 hours to leisurely take it all in and enjoy the moments one by one.
reviews.author: Cathy

reviews.text: We were treated like royalty and were allowed to relax after with a glass of champagne to talk.  The food was beautifully displayed and the service was wonderful.  I would recommend it to anyone for a special treat for their friends or family.  The kids at many tables were welcomed too and seemed to be having fun at their tea party.
reviews.author: Ginger

reviews.text: This is a lovely experience but NOT NOT NOT for $100 a person (and that was not the tea with champagne). The value simply is not there at that price.  A pot of tea, the equivalent of one sandwich, a scone and some tiny petit fours?  This is just way overpriced.  Be aware there is a mandatory service fee so in the end with taxes its $100 a person.
reviews.author: LoveFOOD

reviews.text: What a delightful holiday tea..in a gorgeous setting! Delicious food and non stop Champagne (1st class...champagne!!!) we decided this would be a yearly event...so very special! And...Wanda...made it a perfect afternoon!!!
reviews.author: AZfoodie14

reviews.text: We love Afternoon Tea at the Phoenician!! My friends and I will not go anywhere else for this kind of lovely experience that the Phoenician offers!! Wanda is not just considered staff to us, she is a wonderful, kind lady who takes care of her customers and make the experience extra special! Love her!!! :)
reviews.author: Kristin

reviews.text: Outstanding tea service at this beautiful resort  never fails to excite me! Three incredible courses of savory sandwiches ,cranberry and buttermilk scones and artfully designed desserts! Wonderful selection of teas.And if you select- an endless service of Perrier Jouet! We celebrated our daughter' s graduation so an extra plate of delicious cookies  was served and a special song was played for her! Service and attention to detail ,fabulous  mountain view from the terrace and delicious and beautiful edibles make this a special experience! And at holiday time you can also enjoy the beautiful decorations and gingerbread village in the lobby!  I'll be back again.
reviews.author: Islandgirl

reviews.text: Had Afternoon Tea - absolutely loved it - we've had tea at many different places and the Phoenician tops the list. the food is the best.
reviews.author: Beulah

reviews.text: Loved every minute of High Tea at the Phoenician- from the warm welcome, unlimited pouring a of Veuve Clichot champagne, the delicious and seemingly endless trays of delectable tea sandwiches and desserts- it was a wonderful experience. Wanda, our server was delightful. Compared with other local High Teas, our group of four thought the Phoecian's was the best!
reviews.author: BarreStar

reviews.text: Love Wanda and Natalie for always remembering our favorite selections.  The music and ambience are beautiful.  We will visit each time in town.
reviews.author: SBXlady

reviews.text: Hands down the best afternoon tea in all Phoenix. The service is remarkable and the food is awesome! Highly recommend it for special ocassions and just those weekends in which you want to remember how awesome is to sit at a table and have a great conversation with family and friends. The tea is great, sandwiches are superb and the scones are to die for.
reviews.author: newtophoenix11

reviews.text: Delightful afternoon tea. Service excellent. Great variety of tea and food. Can highly recommend.
reviews.author: Fwtraveler

reviews.text: Service / presentation From Wanda and Natalie was excelant and totally professional !
reviews.author: jimbo

reviews.text: Absolutely love coming here for this wonderful tea.  Have been doing this yearly for 15 years.  It is delightful, the food is scrumptious, and the service excellent.  What can you say about having a waitress who remembers you time after time.  They could not have made my daughter's birthday celebration any more special than they did!  Thank you.
reviews.author: Susieq

reviews.text: I am an officianado of High Tea including Tiffany's, The Strand Palace Hotel, The Empress Hotel, The MacDonald Hotel, Butchart Gardens and The Lake Louise Hotel. This experience was second to none
reviews.author: NichMorison

reviews.text:
It was so wonderful to be at this High Tea in October.  I am a breast cancer survivor and to see all the pink around me including pink champagne (which was VERY good and not sweet) made it all the more special.
I will be returning.  This was my 4th experience. 
The service was wonderful and the piano playing divine!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Best place in the valley to experience Tea with friends and family.  Ask for Wanda if you can for a server as she is excellent and has been their years.
reviews.author: azdiningfan

reviews.text: We have been going to tea for 5 years.  Not once have we been disappointed.  A tried and true gem
reviews.author: Maria

reviews.text: Speaking as high tea enthusiasts, Afternoon Tea at the Phoenician is our new all-time favorite.  The food, tea, champagne, endless refills, fabulous hotel setting, live piano music performance and repertoire, excellent people watching, and incomparable serving team set an impossible standard to beat.  If you have never been to an afternoon tea and can get to Scottsdale, AZ, make this reservation and show up with a good appetite.
reviews.author: T42nuts

reviews.text: My granddaughter and I have come to The Phoenician for High Tea to celebrate her birthday every year since she was eight years old.  The Phoenician outshines any of the other high profile tea houses with its professional servers, quality food and treats, and traditional teas suitable for the Queen herself!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Hostess Natalie is wonderful- super warm, attentive, and accomodating.  Elegant ambience.  Food is excellent, especially the ham and asparagus finger sandwiches and delicious warm scones with Devonshire cream.  Instead of being served all of your food on a platter at once, as at most teas, you are offered a selection of items, one course at a time, and have an opportunity for seconds of your favorites.  Will definitely be back!
reviews.author: Ct2az

reviews.text: Afternoon Tea at the Phoenician provides the perfect ambiance for relaxing, chatting, and just enjoying time with a friend or two.  Tea at the Phoenician follows the English tradition I so enjoyed on my last visit to London.
reviews.author: Broadway

reviews.text: I took my mom for her birthday and wouldn't you know it, they surprised her with a birthday treat and a live piano version of "happy birthday".  It really made her day!  The waitresses were amenable and vibrant and the food was delicious...beautiful view, beautiful music, and beautiful ambiance.  It was very kid friendly too!  I took my 8 month old and we had everything we needed for him.  GO HERE!
reviews.author: Suzana

reviews.text: The food was good though the tea itself was a bit disappointing.  The water they used (I was told) was from the hot reservoir that was filtered but they need to either change their filter or try to use bottled water. The tea couldn't mask the taste of "faucet"water .
reviews.author: Jess

reviews.text: Tea at the Phoenician is always a lovely experience!  Great for a ladies' afternoon or special occasion.  Food and tea are always high quality.  Only complaint is that at some point they started using large teapots for each person and the waitress does not pour the tea!  When we went earlier in the year with older relatives, they could not lift the tea pot - too heavy!!
reviews.author: CarlaS

reviews.text: Afternoon tea at the Phoenician is the epitome of how afternoon tea should be.  Service is outstanding, food is delicious, and the background music with the pianist cannot be beat.  It was relaxing and enjoyable.   We wore our "fashionable" hats to the tea and it made the entire experience so much more fun!
reviews.author: luvtoeat

reviews.text: Wanda served us tea and she is a gem.  Worth every penny.  Food great. Only complaint is that the furniture needs to be cleaned and upgraded.  Not up to the Phoenicians standards
reviews.author: Colorado

reviews.text: The service, the food and the ambiance were all excellent. I would highly recommend this experience to anyone who enjoys afternoon tea. I took my niece and she loved the experience.
reviews.author: MauiRitz

reviews.text: Tea at the Phoenician is always a lovely experience.  The room is bright and comfortable and elegant.  Beautiful table settings with linens and tea service.  The service is outstanding and the 3 courses are delicious.  Six types of sandwiches, followed by scones with jam and lemon curd and cream, followed by six types of desserts.  Have them all, they are wonderful.  Allan plays the Steinway and sings throughout the afternoon.  Tea may also be ordered with champagne.  Make a reservation and take a friend, you will love it!
reviews.author: Annebiz

reviews.text: If you are looking for a formal tea experience matching what the British royal family would consider proper in Phoenix, Arizona, the Phoenician offers the experience daily.  Bring a friend or two along and enjoy the serenity of afternoon tea.
reviews.author: Broadway

reviews.text: It was a splurge to be sure. (For th average person) It cost $130 for 2 that included champagne , tea, finger sandwiches,  scones and delicious deserts. There was a long list of excellent teas to pick from. Service was excellent. The hefty  service fee (automatically added even though there were only two of us) was another big  cost. It took the joy out of tipping for the service given.
reviews.author: marzar

reviews.text: Wanda and Natalie always make afternoon tea a memorable experience.
reviews.author: bernadineS

reviews.text: A wonderful experience.  The hotel is beautiful and the Afternoon Tea was outstanding! Will definitely come again!
reviews.author: JaneR

reviews.text: Afternoon Tea at the Phoenician is like living a scene out of Downton Abbey! We dressed up including hats. Tables were set with gorgeous china and linen. The staff delivered exactly what my daughter dreamed of for her 21st birthday. The food was delicious, unique, and unending! We enjoyed tasting each of the teas our group ordered. The staff was attentive and kept the champagne flowing. Light piano music added a beautiful touch, especially with an elegance rendition Happy Birthday when our server delivered a special dessert. The experience was very high-end and elegant, however the staff was not stiff and snooty but relaxed and friendly, ready to serve and I never felt uncomfortable. We thoroughly enjoyed every minute of our 2 hour tea!
reviews.author: Kwalk

reviews.text: Wonderful tea, wonderful sandwiches and more but the most important part of the tea at the Phoenician is the service. Those ladies have been there for years, they take ownership in what they do and they truly offer superior service that goes beyond a  5 star rating.
reviews.author: Phoenix0413

reviews.text: Natalie and Wanda are the head tea masters and they each offer excellent service. This is my favorite treat to do with my girl friends.
reviews.author: tea4two

reviews.text:
I've been bringing people to the Phoenician for tea for years. I rember the English lady in the white apron.
Wanda is wounderful and has been there for 14 years now.
It is really lovely. $50 seems crazy high for tea when I started coming it was $25 with champagne.
The sandwiches used to be fancier. The are still delicious but simple. Scones are just ok. Desserts very nice.
reviews.author: Localfoodie

reviews.text: I took my daughter and we had a great time. It is a little pricey though
reviews.author: Fish

reviews.text: Many years ago, my mom took me to tea here when I was about 11 years old and it was a fond memory. So I decided, now 10 years later, to take my mom here for tea and it was every bit as great as I remember. Wendy was our server and she was wonderful, putting no pressure on us despite that it was the end of the afternoon tea session and we were the last ones there. Great service, great food, and great tea!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Would recommend this to anyone for a great afternoon!
reviews.author: Lizzy

reviews.text: If you are looking for a special place to take Mom, a sister or a best friend for a special afternoon, look no further. My mom and I enjoyed a traditional afternoon tea. From the place settings, to the delicious three-course tea menu, to the service and the live piano in the background, it was a perfectly memorable experience!
reviews.author: CalmBliss

reviews.text: I have a tradition with a good friend of mine that whenever we meet up in a different city we have high tea together. This was one of the best afternoon teas we've had.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Very expensive and then Phoenician adds a 22% service fee!!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Our experience at the Phoenician was again spectacular. My cousin and I brought 2 young ladies with us and to experience afternoon tea through their eyes was to enjoy our first time there again. Wanda tended to us and I can't say enough how much she made our tea so special. She is an wonderful asset to the Phoenician. Thanks again as we will bring visitors there again. Thanks, Sharon
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: What can we say? Afternoon tea at the Phoenician always makes our day! The food was delicious with generous portions. Sitting on our favorite cozy couch for two looking out at the view was perfect. And, last but not least, Wonderful Wanda our waitress was as charming and delightful as ever! Her sidekick, Natalie, is also lovely. Thank you for a memorable 30th wedding anniversary experience!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: The service was spot on--cheery and attentive but not hovering. The selection of sandwiches and pastries was great. The sandwiches were moist; the scones could have been more so. My sister made a special request for my birthday, which was happily honored. The piano music was lovely. We had a beautiful view of the golf course from our couch. We had a very enjoyable, non-rushed tea, and we can't wait to come again.
reviews.author: ShannonInArizona

reviews.text: We love to treat ourselves whenever I am in Arizona to a special brunch at the Phoenician. Natalie and Wanda are delightful servers and the food is so special. We love the room, the piano, the tea, and the special friendly service. The Phoenician is a must-do treat for ladies that visit Phoenix, and we return at least 4-5 times a year.
reviews.author: SBXlady

reviews.text: Everything was fine, but nothing was outstanding.  A little loud, service a little slow, food kind of dull, not much ambiance.  Valet were extremely rude when we did not tip.  Large obligatory service charge.  For the price, we will not return.
reviews.author: PVShores

reviews.text: We have experienced this tea many times but we will not be going back. Its just too expensive for one pot of tea, 5 one inch slices of sandwich, 2 scones (which have never been good - too dry and crumbly) and five or six small sweets ($150). The upper area is not nice at all. The whole deal takes an hour when for the price you could have an excellent three hour dinner somewhere. Cannot recommend.
reviews.author: LoveFOOD

reviews.text: Excellent as always - a must resort to stop in why'll in scottsdale.
reviews.author: ChaChi

reviews.text:
The Afternoon Tea at the Phoenician is very special. The ambience is classy but comfortable. The service is outstanding---
it's all about making the guest happy and comfortable. I always try to take my guests there. Even though I have been there
many times, I am always pleased with the outstanding service and atmosphere.
reviews.author: chickpea

reviews.text: This is a great spot for traditional afternoon tea. Fun for a girls get together to celebrate a birthday or a shower.
reviews.author: Opentablediner

reviews.text: This was my 5th visit for afternoon tea and as always a wonderful experience! The setting is beautiful, the food delicious, the service impeccable and the piano music divine! As a snowbird, I look forward to this special treat every year.
reviews.author: gogrammago

reviews.text: A wonderful location. The food was beautifully prepared , tasted great, and served impeccably . A very pleasant time for me and my family, Treat yourself to an elegant afternoon.
reviews.author: shade

reviews.text: Think of a time when ladies were still lady-like, when service still happened with a SINCERE smile, and when you actually could leisurely enjoy your meal and company.... That is the high tea service at the Phonecian! I literally have no complaints about my experience, and that's hard to come by nowadays! From the moment we were seated to our departure, every minute was absolutely FABULOUS!!
reviews.author: SilkRuse

reviews.text: My girls and I have been attending afternoon tea at the Phoenician for the last 16 years. We did stray one year and regretted it. The food is good, the atmosphere wonderful, and the service great especially with Wanda, who has been there for 15 years. It always has made for a memorable occasion, especially during the holidays which we were unable to do this year. Nonetheless, we actually liked having done it in January as it seemed more relaxed. Look forward to December when we will do it again.
reviews.author: Susieq

reviews.text: I cant explain how much fun my friends and I had! The food was amazing and you really get your money's worth. I higly recommend having tea here. They make you feel like a princess for a day. My friends and I dressed up in dresses and hats. We had a blast. It's an experience we will never forget.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Having been to the tea at The Ritz and The Biltmore I can absolutely say the tea at The Phoenician is the best! It's the service. Wanda has served my party 2-3 times per year for the last decade. We never want for a thing. Our tea is kept hot, our glasses and plates full. The finger sandwiches are also much better than at other local teas without a doubt. The scones are ok but could use some refinements and the desserts are not a terrible temptation after the 1st 2 courses. Go for the service, the atmosphere, sit with a view of the valley and ask to be seated with Wanda and your experience will be memorable as well as delicious.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Have visited other High Teas around the valley and love here the most.
reviews.author: luvtea

reviews.text: The quality of service is outstanding, the staff is knowledgeable about the teas. The food is outstanding. A wonderful afternoon!
reviews.author: Birthdaygirl

reviews.text: The service was excellent, the food was delicious. It was worth every penny I spent.
reviews.author: JGrue

reviews.text: This is the fourth year I have enjoyed the delightful holiday tea with my daughters and sister in law. The service was wonderful with every need anticipated. The atmosphere put us in the holiday spirit. A great beginning to a lovely season. We wwill be back next year and in many years to come.
reviews.author: Zaccari

reviews.text: This is our second year for Christmas tea at the Phoenician, and we have had tea there several other times. The setting is lovely, but we feel the food quality is not what it used to be, and that the service is less elegant. The price is expensive, and we've decided that the experience is not worth the cost.
reviews.author: susieaz

reviews.text: Afternoon Tea at the Phoenician is the best!!! The service is impeccable!! The food, tea, and champagne is delicious!!!! Wanda is a lovely, sweet person and she clearly loves her job!! She goes out of her way to make sure that you have the best experience possible!!! It wouldn't be the same with Wanda and her warm, friendly smile and demeanor!! The Phoenician is a MUST for afternoon tea!!!
reviews.author: Kristin

reviews.text: From the valet parking to the wait staff everyone as courteous. The food was presented beautifully and tasted great. The tea was also excellent. We particularly enjoyed the piano music and the views.
reviews.author: Jack

reviews.text: Every year we go for High Tea for our Christmas treat. It is one of the highlights of the holiday. Wanda spoils us with such exceptional service I can't imagine a better present! Food is delightful and the Champage is the best!
reviews.author: DivaDarling

reviews.text: We loved our afternoon tea time at the Phoenician! We got to join the Daddy and Daughter Tea time, by mistake, but sure loved the experience. Great food, wonderful and friendly service, and we will definitely return again!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Afternoon tea at the Phoenician is a fabulous experience enhanced by Wanda, the wonder waitress, who exudes charm and a passion for her work. We have had afternoon tea all around the world and the Phoenician afternoon tea experience is definitely at the top of our list! Great food, service and ambience make this a delight which we repeat on a regular basis.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Our servers were attentive and friendly. We were seated on a comfy sofa with a coffee table before us. It was quite comfortable. Each course came out in a timely manner, and if we weren't quite finished with the previous course they went back and waited until we were ready. The old standards played by the pianist did a wonderful job of setting a lovely mood for the afternoon. Plus, the gluten free options for my friend were an added touch! I had asked prior to placing my reservation on Open Table. Overall, I would definitely recommend Afternoon Tea at The Phoenician!
reviews.author: MysTechnoFoodie

reviews.text: The Phoenician Hotel is understated luxury at it's finest well represented by a five star afternoon tea experience at a very moderate price.
reviews.author: Arealgem24k

reviews.text: I was disappointed to find that the finger sandwiches and desserts were not as good as in previous visits. The tea is now served in overly large teapots; and we were not offered refills of more hot water, or the option to try other teas. Just not as good as I remember it last time...
reviews.author: Kwren

reviews.text: My son who wanted to suprise his girlfriend for her birthday. High tea at the Phoenician knocked it out of the park! She loved it. The food was delicious, and the service was impecable. The pace of service allowed them to enjoy the food, champagne and piano background completely at their leisure. Dress is formal but the setting is comfortable, with tables placed about loveseats and living room type chairs. The tea menu is quite extensive. They were served a variety of delicious finger sandwiches, followed by scones with jam and sweet cream, then an impressive selection of desserts. Girlfriend could not stop smiling and mentioned she will bring her mom here for Mother's day. I hope she includes me in that invitation!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: went for my anniversary, my wife just loved it and can't wait to come back. The only complaint I have is the automatic 22% gratuity that is added to EVERY check, no matter the quality of service. I find this in very poor taste to mandate and force the tip amount on people. I have no problem giving the servers a great tip, I just don't want me to be forced to pay it. I probably would have tipped more for the excellent time, but the mandatory tip left a real sour taste after such an enjoyable time.
reviews.author: JeffI

reviews.text: We were made to feel so welcome when we went for afternoon tea. Nothing was too much trouble for the attentive staff. Our attendant - can't call her a waitress or a server - kept a watchful eye and anticipated our every need. The low-key piano music was such a bonus ....
reviews.author: NorahH

reviews.text: This was my second time attending Tea at the Phonecian. I was brought in December 2012 with friends and loves my experience so much I wanted to treat my mother to a special birthday treat. Online reservations were so easy to make and the reminder email prior to the day was wonderful. We were greeted immediately by one of the waitresses and were seated before our 2pm reservation. The other waitress recognized me from my last visit and came over to chat and emphatically thanked us for our patronage. The food was delectable and the tea was lovely even on a hot afternoon. My mother told me afterwards that she felt pampered and so special. I was so pleased that we had yet another beautiful experience.
reviews.author: LeesieRN

reviews.text: Beautiful high tea albeit a little pricey for tiny sandwiches. Tea and dessert but worth it for the ambience!
reviews.author: astrums

reviews.text: Room is nice but tables could be bigger. Staff could be more knowledgeable concerning the types of teas offered, although the tea itself was good.
reviews.author: Frank

reviews.text: Almost everything was perfect when my sister and I had high tea at The Phoenician. The food was delicious, especially the scones. There was a good variety of teas to choose. We had the orange spice white tea. It was fragrant and reminiscent of autumn/winter desserts. The service was exceptional. The only minor blemish to our experience here was the resorts guest walking around us in their resort wear.
reviews.author: just0lovely

reviews.text: Such a great experience. Can't wait to go again.
reviews.author: Reviewer

reviews.text: I have been taking tea with my daughters since they were little girls. Sometimes, we go just for the heck of it and sometimes we go to celebrate a milestone in their lives. Tea at The Phoenician will always hold a special place in our hearts and memory banks.
reviews.author: SDVIEWS

reviews.text: Everything about tea at The Phoenician was wonderful! Natalie, our server, truly made the day a spectacular occasion! She was personable, helped us pick our teas and encouraged us to eat as much as we wanted (and even more). Also, she helped my mom pick a second pot of tea to enjoy with her desserts. And when we were too full to eat many desserts, she boxed as many as we wanted. The final special moment was when Natalie brought a plate with 4 yummy cookies and a chocolate Happy Birthday banner. How very thoughtful!! My mom and I have been to many great places for tea, but The Phoenician tea ranks at the top of our list.
reviews.author: Retired1

reviews.text: Always a favorite for special celebrations. We love the scones, so make sure you don't drink too much tea so you can eat the wonderful treats.
reviews.author: Luv2Travel

reviews.text: My best friend and I have afternoon tea at the Phoenician whenever I am in town from the midwest. The ambience is lovely and the food selection never fails to entice us. We have a great "girls" afternoon. It is always an extra treat to see that Natalie is our server. She is sweet, good natured, and attentive. We'll be back again in June!
reviews.author: SBXlady

reviews.text: I have been to afternoon tea at the Four Seasons in San Diego and the Ritz in SF, it is comparable and would return for tea at the Phoenician .Wonderful experience and would definitely recommend for a special treat. The food and service was perfect.
reviews.author: Goodfoods

reviews.text: Great afternoon tea!!! Sandwiches, pastries, tea and service was outstandig would recommend to anyone.
reviews.author: luv2dine

reviews.text:
Lovely change of pace. A beautiful place for a special meal, great service, perfect views. The piano music is wonderful, a ladies day out without compare. I've had tea in many places, but always come back to the Phoenician.

Afterwards, we end up on the balcony, and invite the guys to come have a drink.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
Was not very impressed with the Food.
Rest was awesome...
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: We thoroughly enjoyed Afternoon Tea the Phoenician. They offered an abundant selection of teas, our two choices were amazing! The service was wonderful as was the table setting. I liked being next to the patio and seeing the beautiful resort and Phoenix landscape. It was dissapointing having resort guests (dressed in their shorts, flip flops and sun suits) walk through our beautiful tea time. An expected result, I guess visiting a resort. We will go again.
reviews.author: Birthdaygirl

reviews.text: The best afternoon tea experience on this side of the Atlantic -- and rivals those on the other side as well. The service is consummate, the ambiance charming and elegant without being fussy, yet remains comfortable, the food and tea choices are generous and delicious, and there's even live piano music to top it all off. Seconds are offered after each of three courses, and each guest gets their own pot of tea, with seconds offered. We all loved every minute of it, and plan to return again soon. It's a great spot to bring out-of-towners, who are always impressed. Each seat has a nice view. While we've been to the Phoenician's tea numerous times before, it never gets "stale." We've never failed to have an absolutely delightful experience.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: This was our first time at The Phoenician for Afternoon Tea. They truly have mastered the art of taking tea. The food was delicious and we really enjoyed the man playing the piano. The service was impeccable.
reviews.author: Olivia

reviews.text: It is always such a very special treat to have afternoon tea at the Phoenician. I lived in England for seven years and this experience is, indeed, quite authentic. Over the years I have brought my daughters-in-laws to be here, my husband for a Valentine's Day treat and a friend for her birthday. My favorite tea sandwich is the dainty ham and asparagus - and the lemon curd served with the scones is delicious. The service is impeccable. You'll love it!
reviews.author: Izzysgarden

reviews.text: Perfect, what else would you expect from the Phoenician
reviews.author: AzJude

reviews.text: Fabulous place to have Afternoon Tea. Great location.
reviews.author: ToniA

reviews.text: Phoenician knows how to do everything just right! Our hostess/server, Natalie, is a keeper - we ask for her each time we come for tea. Outstanding day from service to ambience. A perfect afternoon.
reviews.author: GwenA

reviews.text: For the past 8 years, I have brought my daughter for her birthday to the Phoenician for Afternoon Tea and it never fails to impress. Elegant, classy, and the service is always impeccable. A special notation to Wanda for always making this an enjoyable afternoon, whom we have seen every year. Fabulous!
reviews.author: PamM

reviews.text: A lovely day celebrating a special Birthday with my Mother and her friends.
reviews.author: BarbS

reviews.text: We have been to Afternoon Teas in our local Fairmont Hotel and wanted to try a new venue. All of us enjoyed the sparkling wine with our lunch which added a more festive flavor. The food at The Phoenician is served rather than offered on a tiered platter as at the Fairmont. We were offered seconds, so no one left hungry. The scones are the best part of the meal, and we were offered one very large cranberry and one very large plain scone. The highlight of our meal was the service offered by Wanda. She made the afternoon a memorable one and we will be back as long as she is there. If you have never been to an Afternoon Tea we would highly recommend that you try this one.
reviews.author: Momm53

reviews.text: From the gracious greeting to the elegant table settings and the soft piano music, this made the perfect place for a small afternoon birthday celebration. We could actually carry on a conversation without shouting, the staff did not hover asking how things were (And insinuating that they wanted you to be finished. Soon!), and the food was delightful. Boredom is guaranteed for young ones not accustomed to sitting quietly, and crying disturbs everyone else, so be thoughtful of your children and others. Definitely more of a ladies' venue, but gentleman would enjoy it as well if they have an open mind and an empty stomach -- the goodies just kept coming! Treat yourself to a glass of champagne and complete the experience. Enjoy!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Everything about the tea was great. Elegant & delicious!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Just go! Not many places in the US for afternoon tea that is this fabulous. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: It was a beautiful, traditional high tea with all the trimmings. The food, service and people were fabulous. You felt very special as if you we're royalty.
reviews.author: dlkap1

reviews.text: The atmosphere was relaxed and enjoyable. The view was spectacular and added to the ambiance.The food was good although the desserts could have been better.
reviews.author: LYNNC

reviews.text: An especially lovely experience to enjoy with folks who like tea. The live piano music made it even more enjoyable.
reviews.author: davidk

reviews.text: This is the second time we've enjoyed tea at the Phoenician. They can accommodate most requests (ours was a pickier eater), the service has been excellent, and the whole experience very enjoyable. They are pricier than most "tea rooms", but you really do get what you pay for here.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: I met a friend aand expected that for around $45 each we would have flawless service food and tea. They accommodated my gluten free requirement (they brought in some scones and cupcakes from GFC after I called ahead) and made snacks without bread. We sat facing out so to enjoy the view and it's worth noting the crowd is much much older than my 30 year old self, but that is to be expected, especially since we came because we're tea fans. While the resort is beautiful, it is dated. The furniture was sunken and faded, though that didn't ruin the experience. The waitstaff made themselves scarce but were attentive enough, though surprised when my friend and I both ordered pots of tea instead of sharing. Had a great time, likely won't be back.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: a nice formal tea: great sandwiches & tea, good scones but desert was too sugary. pricey, but a good experience.
reviews.author: golfer7

reviews.text: My friend and I had a wonderful afternoon sipping tea and snacking on delicious sandwiches, scones and deserts.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: The most wonderful, marvelous experience! Truly a lovely way to spend New Year's Day catching up with friends. Very relaxing and fun! A great new tradition to do on New Year's Day now.
reviews.author: iLo823

reviews.text: This was our second annual holiday tea. My ten year old daughter looks forward to our tea every holiday season. The decorative tea room id festive and relaxing. We look forward to our next holiday. Loved it so much we may visit several times during the year.
reviews.author: Zaccari

reviews.text: The staff is amazing every time. Keep it the way it is.
reviews.author: Tina

reviews.text: Great holiday tradition with the girls in my family. The Phoenician has a beautiful and elegant atmosphere without being stuffy. The staff is very friendly and accommodating. The only negative is that because of the busy season and numbers of people attending tea it did take away from the leisurely experience that afternoon tea should provide.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Afternoon tea at the Phoenician is always elegant. Perfect for celebrating any special occasion!
reviews.author: susieaz

reviews.text: Absolutely love afternoon tea at The Phoenician.
reviews.author: CynthiaH

reviews.text: I go to high tea at the Phoenician every December to get my holiday season off to a good start. They have such beautiful holiday decorations. The staff is attentive and I always know my friends and I will receive wonderful service.
reviews.author: ValleySun70

reviews.text:
Thia is the first time I went for High Tea at the Phoenician. Everything was as I had expected- outstanding food and service in a lovely setting. You will be treated royally and can have as much or as little as you like of everything.We started with Perrier Jouet Brut Champagne and finger sandwiches, moved on to tea and bisquits with devonshire cream, jam and lemon curd, and ended with a tray of lovely petite desserts. Everyone should try this afternoon tea performance at least once. I attended with my daughter but there were plenty of men there as well. Looks like everyone was celebrating something....
Pricey but worth what you receive in terms of quality and quantity. We will return.
reviews.author: Islandgirl

reviews.text: A beautiful setting with an impressive tea menu! Sad that my friend and I had to be seated with a huge noisy party right next to us..prefer a quiet setting with easy conversational ambiance.
reviews.author: JanR

reviews.text: Christmas decorations were wonderful. It is such a beautiful setting for our annual Christmas tea. It was expensive but special.
reviews.author: MarjorieH

It was elegant, the food was delicious, the service was amazing, the view was incredible, AND i did not feel out of place in my very casual clothes. No one batted an eye when I came in wearing jeans and sandals. This will now be my favorite thing to do when an out of town guest comes to visit. Heck, I might even have to go back with my husband.

Highly recommend this experience. I have always loved the Phoenician and High Tea did not disappoint.

Food generous and decent-tasting, but quality seemed more like a cost-cutting hotel.

reviews.text: I usually do afternoon tea in every major city I visit, including foreign cities, and I still have yet to experience an afternoon tea ceremony better than the Phoenician. The food, tea selection, service, music, ambiance, and unlimited champagne are truly top notch.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
I WAS VERY PLEASED WITH THE EXPERIENCE. SERIVCE WAS EXCELLENT.
THE WEBSITE SAID FORMAL ATTIRE. YOU MAY WANT TO CHANGE THAT TO BUSINESS ATTIRE.
NO ONE WAS IN FORMAL ATTIRE, ESPECIALLY IN THE AFTERNOON WITH 104 DEGERES.
reviews.author: JEANR

reviews.text: EXCELLENT place for afternoon tea. I took my 2 daughters and the food, tea AND service was amazing! Highly recommend it. We had a delightful time!
reviews.author: LisaK

reviews.text: Afternoon tea is almost a thing of the past. Not at the Phoenician where it is still done with bone English china, a great loose tea selection and wonderful ambiance. It has gotten a little pricier than when I first started going however for something special, it is worth it. You leave full and happy.
reviews.author: MoniqueH

reviews.text: We were celebrating significant birthdays and so enjoyed ourselves at the Phoenician Tea. We had a choice of a couch with lower table or a chair and couch with regular height table. There were pillows all around for comfortable sitting. There were many herbal drinks which really aren't "tea." I would have preferred more choices of flavored green white and black tea. The first course of tea sandwiches had a wonderful variety. The asparagus sandwich was great. The second course was scones with jams and cream...also wonderful. the third course was sweets with a nice variety. Everything was extremely tasty, but nothing was outstanding/unforgettable.
reviews.author: CindyH

reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience at my first High Tea when visiting Phoenix. Wonderful tea sandwiches, scones and desserts with a full pot of a broad selection of fine teas. There was also live piano music. Service was friendly and prompt, but never rushed. When in Phoenix again, I will definitely go back.
reviews.author: KiraO

reviews.text: Ok it was fancy. The food was terrific. The service was too. But the tea was ground too small and went through the strainer into my cup. So it was gross. If I wanted to drink any of it I had to wait for the leaves to settle at the bottom. I asked the server about it and all she did was switch my cup. How would that help? Chuck the leaves and start again! Or allow me to choose another tea. Not cool. Plus it was pretty noisy. It's right off the lobby. Barely heard the awesome pianist. It would be nice to sit closer to the view. Next stop- the Ritz.
reviews.author: Phoenician

reviews.text: My daughter and I enjoyed our special time at this beautiful place
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Lovely as always with impeccable service!

reviews.text: Lovely setting for a lovely tea experience. Scrumptious finger sandwiches, buttery scones, and an array of dessert bites. Not to mention a big assortment of teas. Each person gets a full tea pot. We went home totally relaxed, rejuvenated and full. Loved it!
reviews.author: ChristineG

reviews.text: The location right off of the lobby is a bit awkward. The finger sandwiches were bland and not up to Phoenician standards. The desserts were unique and the best part of the high tea food choices. We were seated at a coffee table on a small couch. I would not return for high tea.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: This was my 4th time attending an Afternoon Tea at the Phoenician. One word - Superb. Wanda has been our server twice now and she goes above and beyond the call of duty. Beautiful atmosphere. Soft piano music playing in the background. Every course well executed and delicious. Extensive tea list. Always a great experience.
reviews.author: JaneeG

reviews.text: Went there for Mother's Day and had so much fun. The food was good. The tea was delicious. Nothing beats the view of the mountains.
reviews.author: CKAZ

reviews.text:
My all-time favorite place for afternoon tea. Whenever I have a house guest, this is one of the "must dos". The ambiance is wonderful, the service impeccable and the piano music perfect!
The different savory to sweet offerings are both eye appealing and so scrumptious...served with gracious attention to every detail. You will be treated like "Royalty".
reviews.author: Cooky

reviews.text: Looking forward to doing it again.
reviews.author: Phoenix

reviews.text: Best "tea experience" in town
reviews.author: Localfoodie

reviews.text: My sister and I decided to celebrate our double birthday at the Phoenician for their Grand Royale afternoon tea, which is the package that includes unlimited Champagne. We were very impressed with the quality, amount, and presentation of the food of the 3-course tea (a colorful array of dainty sandwiches, which they gave us "one of each" to try -- twice! Then two scones - plain/butter and cranberry with clotted cream, strawberry jam and lemon curd; and finally, another mouthwatering array of various pastries and chocolates). The Champagne, as well, was of high quality - Perrier-Jouet -and the tea selections were lovely, with each person receiving their own individual Wedgewood tea pot. Request couch or table seating.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Afternoon tea at the Phoenician is absolutely wonderful. Everything was perfect, the ambience, the service, the food, the pianist.... All four of us enjoyed this experience immensely. We are all lovers of afternoon tea and this experience is definitely among the best in the world! After our indulgence, it was lovely to walk in the Phoenician's fabulous botanical gardens.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: What a delightful experience! Everything was perfect, from the lovely tea sandwiches (delicious!) to the dessert pastries (who could resist - I had one of each!), the pristine white tablecloths and the elegant china. The service was impeccable and the courses were timed just right. My friend and I were both celebrating birthdays, and after everything else, when were were completely stuffed, they brought out a plate of cookies for each of us as our birthday treat. Needless to say, those came home with each of us!
reviews.author: SusanW

reviews.text:
Over the years I have enjoyed the High Tea at the Phoenician many times. While still good and enjoyable, it no longer is as exceptional as it once was:
* servers no longer discuss or explain the different characteristics of Teas offered on the menu to help first time guests make the their best selection
*less variety in finger sandwiches
*less variety in pastry choices
*servers no longer pour tea or check for refills unless requested by guests
* lemons no longer served in silver squeeze tool, and guests have to squeeze them with their fingers

All in all not the outstanding experience in service and quality it used to be - guess, depressed economy apparently causes cutbacks and drop in service quality even in this classy hotel
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Beautiful lobby setting so you can people watch too. Excellent selection of sandwiches, 2 different scones, and many assorted desserts. Seconds are presented as routine. You will not finish hungry so even men can enjoy the tea as a meal. A pianist provides unobtrusive background music. The atmosphere was relaxed and comfortable. You can self park and walk to the lobby. My daughter and I enjoyed it immensely. I will definitely go again.

was over the top. The price was not listed upon making the reservations, so I did not

The ambiance is wonderful from the music and room to the beautiful view. The service was friendly, the food tasty; my friend and I had a great time. It is a excellent place for a special celebration.

reviews.text: Always a special treat to have ladies tea at the Phoenician. Food and service were fantastic and I look forward to being back soon.

reviews.text: Afternoon Tea was absolutely spectacular. It was so very English, so very elegant, proper, etc. The food was excellent. The plate settings were also 'spot on,' truly British. (Wedgwood china, tea set, and silverware throughout.) The selection of teas is almost overwhelming, but one more reason to return for Tea again and again. The hotel itself is also very elegant. What a wonderful place to relax and have High Tea. We can't wait to go back. It is most definitely on our list of places to eat when we return to Scottsdale.

reviews.text: Sandwiches were very good as well as the pastries. Scores were a bit dry and too cold for my taste. We were too close to the piano so I felt like I had to talk too loud. Still we had a great tea and I would return.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: I have had tea at several Valley locations, and this was my fourth visit to the Phoenician because I consider it to be the best of them all. I love the excellent service, the food is high quality and there are no "restrictions" to how many of any one thing you might want. The piano playing in the background is a bonus to the beautiful setting of the lobby of the resort. I'll return many times!!!
reviews.author: bikrgrl

reviews.text: my wife and Ihave enjoyed afternoon tea in several locations around the country. The Phonecian was our best experience yet. Would hightly recmmend to anyone.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: I was very pleased with this afternoon tea. The selection and quality of sandwiches was much better than others I have tried and there was plenty of jam and cream for the scones which is often a problem. The tea selection was good and the strength was just right. I really like that everything was served separately instead of being squashed together on a three-tier serving tray. The lobby at the Phoenician is beautiful and the presentation of the tea was really nice. My only complaint is that they allow children here - how they can actually appreciate something like this is beyond me.

reviews.text:
Afternoon Tea at the Phoenician is wonderful for a special occasion.
The food - all three courses - was delicious. The expanse of windows gave a wonderful panoramic view - I'm sure that at night it's also lovely. The service was excellent; the servers were attentive and friendly, and the transitions between courses was seamless. We never felt rushed. The piano was lovely and unobtrusive, so no one had to strain to hear the conversation.
This is the most elegant venue I've enjoyed tea in, in the Phoenix area.
reviews.author: ZonaLady

reviews.text: My Mom, Aunt and good friends had a wonderful afternoon at the Phoenician where we enjoyed a champagne afternoon tea. This will be my 4th visit with visiting guests from my home country of England and it has certainly surpassed most of the afternoon teas I have had back home. Each time has been consistently excellent. The waitress even remembered me and my mom (2 years since our last visit) she was thrilled, Kudos to the tea rooms at the Phoenician! See you again next year...
reviews.author: Fran

reviews.text: An elegant afternoon tea to enjoy with girlfriends and family. The service is outstanding and the view is breathtaking. Relaxing and enjoyable. You are not rushed and can enjoy your tea, finger sandwiches, scones, and desserts for hours without feeling pushed out. A wonderful way to spend an afternoon. Everyone should go for afternoon tea once in their lives!!
reviews.author: candyb

reviews.text: A great treat for a special occasion.

A third employee finally helped us. I would give it another try but very disappointing for the "5 star Phoenician Resort". Also, to mention I tried 6 times to call the resort to change my party size.
